CBRE, Inc., as exclusive advisor to Ownership, is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire the Killingly Oaks Business Park Industrial Land Parcels located at 220 Lake Road & 27 Forbes Road, Killingly, CT (the “Property”).

The Property totals 20.86 acres of industrial land situated midway between Hartford, CT and Providence, RI, and proximate to both the New York City and Boston MSAs. The Property is positioned in a highly desirable New England distribution market home to nearly 40 million residents within a 200-mile radius. Substantiating the desirability of the distribution market, the local area is home to largescale industrial and distribution facilities occupied by Walgreens, UNFI, Amazon, Frito-Lay, International Paper, Lowe’s, and Staples, to name a few.

The Property is surrounded by an abundance of major highways and is approximately 1-mile from two, 4-way interchanges along Interstate 395, which provides access to Interstate 90 to the north and Interstate 95 to the south.

listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale the ±4.6-acre land parcel located at 110 Henkel Way in the Corporate Ridge business park in Rocky Hill, CT.

Situated prominently on the corner of Brook St. and Henkel Way, 110 Henkel Way is the last remaining development site at Corporate Ridge, boasting convenient highway access, flexible OP zoning with a variety of permitted end uses, and an excellent location within the master-planned Corporate Ridge business park. Corporate Ridge is one of central Connecticut’s premier mixed-use parks, located immediately off Interstate 91 via a full interchange at Exit 23. The Park features a 247-room Sheraton Hotel, WFSB Channel 3’ Broadcast HQ, Orthopedic Associates of Hartford’s surgery center, Henkel’s corporate campus, and four Class A office buildings. The Park is also home to two planned multifamily projects, including 96 apartments currently under construction opposite the subject property at 125 Henkel Way.

This premier land site offers a rare opportunity for development in a highly sought-after, well established submarket with all major utilities easily accessible from the street including water & sewer, natural gas and electric. The property is available for sale without a formal asking price.

listings.headline: Boutique Mixed-Use Office Space for Lease or Sale in Downtown New Haven
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale or lease, 837 Chapel Street, a four-story, boutique retail/office building measuring approximately 26,000 SF.

Built in 1888, 837 Chapel Street boasts turn-of-the century architecture combined with modern upgrades including completely code compliant new elevator, mechanical and fire/life safety systems. The property consists of lower level “cabaret” space, ground level retail, and three floors of upper level office space.
listings.locationDescription: This historic property offers an excellent location in downtown New Haven, walkable to all CBD amenities and public transportation including Union and State Street stations. Currently vacant, it represents the opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant to acquire a unique property with flexible usage options. These options include the potential to convert the upper office floors into multi-family residences, in an area currently undergoing significant revitalization and new development.
highlights: Originally constructed in 1882 with major renovation in 1898 including a new carved limestone facade.
The 1898 facade was designed by prominent New Haven architect Leoni Robinson.
The building is named for Henry F. English, its original owner.
The building is officially a contributing structure to the Chapel Street Historical District.

CBRE is pleased to present the opportunity to purchase 125 Powder Forest Drive, being offered for sale at an asking price of $2,600,000.  The Property was constructed in 1988 for Veeder-Root, who currently leases 28,475 RSF through December 31, 2028.  

125 Powder Forest Drive presents a unique value-add reposition opportunity in the Farmington Valley, boasting over 570 feet of frontage on Route 10/202, elevator access, institutional quality construction on ±9 acres, flexible zoning, and location in a well-established, highly desirable affluent suburban community.
listings.locationDescription:
Simsbury, Connecticut

Simsbury is a picturesque New England town known for its natural beauty, abundant outdoor recreation, and highly favorable demographics characterized by a strong sense of community. The town is federally designated as a “Preserve America” community and has been ranked as one of the best places to live in America. Nestled in the Farmington River Valley between two dramatic mountain ridges, Simsbury offers an idyllic natural setting combined with historic, small-town charm - boasting quaint homes, historic inns, local shops, and acclaimed restaurants amidst extensive hiking and biking trails, two golf courses, working farms, a vineyard, an outdoor performing arts center and prominent local landmarks like the Hublein Tower, which sits atop Talcott Mountain overlooking the Farmington River and beyond.
highlights: Short-Term Positive Cash Flow with Veeder Root Tenancy through 12/31/2028

listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale approximately 7 acres of undeveloped land on Simsbury Road in Avon, Connecticut. The site is situated along busy Route 10/202 (Simsbury Rd) offering 340 of frontage on Route 202, which boasts an average daily traffic count of 10,400 VDP.

The parcel is zoned CP-A, which allows a wide variety of permitted uses including restaurants, retail, professional office, medical office, hotel, recreational facilities (indoor), retail stores, and entertainment. The property has also been identified in the town's 2022-2027 Affordable Housing Plan as suitable for multi-family or cluster-style development. Developers can apply for the Attainable Housing Overlay Zone (AHOZ), which encourages mixed-use projects and requires 20% of all new homes to be affordable.

The property is being marketed for sale at an asking price of $2.25 million.

listings.headline: Unique Redevelopment Opportunity in Litchfield Hills
listings.description:
Situated in the quiet northwest corner of Connecticut, 17 Church St. N. is an historic 19th Century church property that has served as the long-time home of the North Congregational Church of New Hartford. The building boasts striking architectural details including a stately brick masonry exterior, towering cupola, and beautiful stained glass windows. The property consists of the single-story sanctuary/congregation area and an attached two-story annex building, which houses classrooms, a kitchen, restrooms, and a large gathering hall, in addition to a full basement with storage and a mechanical room.

THE OFFERING:
The North Congregational Church of New Hartford will be vacating its long-term home at 17 Church St. N., presenting a unique opportunity for a non-profit, municipal, educational owner-occupant or multifamily developer. The property is being offered for sale at an asking price of $650,000.
listings.locationDescription: 17 Church St. N offers an excellent location one block from Route 44 among the picturesque Litchfield Hills just east of the Farmington River in New Hartford. New Hartford is a small rural town with a population of less than 7,000 people and average household income of $123,000. Recreational opportunities abound, including skiing at Ski Sundown, river tubing, hiking, biking, fishing, swimming and boating. The Litchfield Hills area also boasts a thriving local art scene, wineries, antiques, and farmers markets. Routes 44 and 219 provide immediate access to the building and New Hartford‘s historic town center.

listings.headline: Excellent Industrial User Building or Investor Repositioning Opportunity on 5.11 Acres in Danbury, CT
listings.description:
CBRE, Inc. is pleased to offer for sale 55 Old Ridgebury Road, a 5.1-Acre site, that consists of a ±42,500 SF, single-story flex/light industrial building and a ±3,000 SF maintenance depot located in Danbury, Connecticut. The main building is fully leased by Linde, who has been in occupancy since 2006.  The maintenance building is leased by Carmine Labriola Contracting Corp. (CLCC), who has been in occupancy since 2008.  Both the Linde and CLCC leases expire January 31, 2027.

The main building at 55 Old Ridgebury Road is a single-tenant occupied facility featuring above-standard electrical capacity (with two feeds for a 13,800-volt substation), redundant emergency power (supplied by four onsite generators), raised floor data center, 13‘ 4“ ceiling heights, two loading docks with load levelers, and surface parking for ±120 vehicles.  Linde currently utilizes the Property as a data center for their primary business operations and for the company‘s hospital support services but will be vacating the property upon lease expiration, providing an ideal opportunity for an industrial building user that would benefit from the existing infrastructure. The entire 5.11-acre site is zoned IL-40 (Light Industrial), with neighboring industrial users including Lansing, Parker Industries and Owl Cyber Security.

Situated in a strong industrial market and growing commercial area near the New York State Border and Boehringer Ingleheim‘s corporate headquarters campus, 55 Old Ridgebury Road represents the opportunity for an investor or owner-occupant to acquire a property with short-term positive cash flow, an excellent location, and superior in-place infrastructure.  The 5.11-acre site size and flexible zoning also allow the potential for adaptive reuse/redevelopment to self-storage, multifamily or logistics.

The property is being offered for sale without a formal asking price.
listings.locationDescription:
55 Old Ridgebury Road is located in Fairfield County in the City of Danbury, Connecticut, on the western border with the State of New York. Danbury is a vibrant residential and economic hub with a population of nearly 87,000 and a median household income of $79,000. 

Encompassing nearly 126 square miles, Danbury is the 3rd largest city in Western Connecticut, boasting a solid, established infrastructure, with access to a robust interstate highway system, healthcare (Danbury Hospital Medical Center), education (Western Connecticut State University), and public transportation (Metro-North Rail-Danbury Station; Danbury Municipal Airport).

Danbury has developed into a vibrant business center in the Northern Fairfield Market due to three primary factors that benefit both corporations and employees — easy access from Westchester County, New York (I-684/I-84), southern Fairfield County (I-84 and Route 7) and New York City (120+/- minute train ride), in addition to significantly lower office rents and reduced housing costs in comparison to southern Fairfield County and parts of Westchester. This transportation and economic infrastructure has attracted major corporate occupants including Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals, Honeywell International, Hologoic, Nuvance Health the Barden Corporation, and many others.

listings.headline: Gateway Investment Opportunity - Port Chester, NY
listings.description:
Please visit the Property Website to obtain access to the Offering Memorandum.

CBRE has been retained as the exclusive advisor for the sale of 10 Mill Street, a ±0.22‑acre parcel improved with a ±4,928 SF freestanding retail building prominently positioned at the corner of Mill Street and Abendroth Avenue, in the Village of Port Chester, within the Town of Rye. The pedestrian‑oriented location sits just one block from US Route 1 in the heart of Port Chester’s vibrant downtown. Strategically situated at a highly visible gateway into the Village—one of the first properties encountered when entering from Greenwich’s Byram neighborhood—the site offers exceptional prominence and accessibility.

The waterfront property benefits from a prime, transit‑oriented setting within downtown Port Chester. Directly across the street is The Abendroth, a newly constructed 209‑unit multifamily community. The Property is also within walking distance of more than 500 recently delivered multifamily units and just 0.3 miles from the Port Chester Metro‑North Train Station. Its central location, one block from US Route 1 and 0.5 miles from Interstate 95, positions the site to capitalize on continued urban development and the area’s strong economic momentum.

Located within affluent Westchester County, approximately 25 miles northeast of Midtown Manhattan, the Property sits along the Byram River, forming the eastern border of Port Chester. The Village benefits from close proximity to Greenwich, Connecticut, one of the wealthiest communities in the United States. Residents from both Greenwich and Westchester are drawn to Port Chester’s well‑known dining scene—a dynamic mix of high‑end culinary concepts and authentic ethnic eateries, including several offering waterfront seating.

Labor availability in the surrounding area is robust, with approximately 732,000 workers within a 10‑mile radius. Port Chester is part of the I‑287 East Submarket, comprising roughly 6.18 million square feet of retail inventory. As of Q1 2026, the submarket maintains a low vacancy rate of 3.2%. Average asking rents are $42.85 per SF, supported by consistent annual rent growth averaging 1.9% over the past decade. Current year‑over‑year rent growth stands at 2.1%, outperforming the broader New York metro area at 1.3%. With no new retail construction underway, supply‑side pressure remains minimal, underscoring the submarket’s strength and attractiveness to investors.

10 Mill Street represents a rare opportunity to acquire a vacant retail asset in a thriving, walkable downtown environment, supported by strong demographics, exceptional visibility, and sustained demand fundamentals.

Orange County has become a focal point for industrial users searching for operational efficiencies and lower cost alternatives to the sharply higher lease rates and costs in NJ and PA. The Port Authority continues to invest in Stewart International Airport as they redirect cargo from JFK, La Guardia, and Newark Liberty International Airport.

This expansive property offers exceptional potential for entertainment, live performance, and specialty commercial ventures, with two substantial buildings across 12.78 acres in one of Hampton Roads’ most accessible and desirable submarkets. Its size, visibility, and proximity to major transportation routes make it an ideal candidate for a premier concert venue, regional event hub, or transformative mixed-use, retail, or multifamily(housing) redevelopment.

The first parcel at 580 Kempsville Road, the preferred property for sale, spans 7.52 acres and features an ±80,000 SF modern facility with a sanctuary seating up to 5,200 guests—perfect for large-scale concerts, conferences, and community events. The second parcel at 640 Kempsville Road includes a two-story, 95,000 SF building on 5.26 acres, offering flexible space for production, storage, or adaptive reuse to support entertainment operations or complementary commercial uses. This property can be  available for purchase as well. Together, these properties deliver a rare combination of scale, location, and versatility for investors and operators seeking a high-impact presence in Hampton Roads.

CBRE is pleased to offer 4740 Chudoba Parkway, a 32,500‑square‑foot, single‑tenant industrial facility situated on an expansive 18.5‑acre site (10 - 12 Acres Usable). Constructed in 1999, the property features an efficient and versatile industrial layout with 21–22‑foot clear heights, two existing dock‑high doors, and two drive‑in doors, accommodating a wide range of manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution users.

The building is equipped with natural gas, power ranging from 2,000 to 3,000 amps, and electric service provided by Prince George Electrical Cooperative. Approximately 5,000 square feet of existing office space (two floors) supports operational and administrative needs. Zoned Industrial, the property accommodates a broad spectrum of industrial uses, offering long‑term flexibility for both owner‑users and investors.

The substantial excess land provides rare and valuable flexibility for outside storage, yard space, or future expansion—an increasingly limited feature in assets of this size.

Its position within Prince George County’s established industrial corridor enhances connectivity and supports logistics, manufacturing, and distribution uses.

Available for sale, 4740 Chudoba Parkway presents a compelling opportunity for users seeking immediate functionality and scalability, as well as investors targeting a well‑located industrial asset in a growing sub‑market.

listings.name: Former TC3 Residence Halls
listings.headline: Opportunity to Redevelop Modern Residence Halls with Flexible End-Use Potential
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to present a rare opportunity to acquire and redevelop a three-building portfolio of modern, purpose-built residence halls located on the campus of Tompkins-Cortland Community College (TC3). With construction starting in 2008, these contemporary buildings offer robust, institutional-quality, modern infrastructure and efficient layouts, making them ideal for adaptive reuse into a variety of possible residential formats, including apartments, workforce housing, veterans housing, senior living/age-restricted communities, and more. The development project has excellent potential to fulfill the need for community-serving projects and may be eligible for grants and incentives.

The offering consists of three buildings totaling 117,000 SF on 28.05 AC (to be subdivided) with relatively high elevation, offering breathtaking vistas of the surrounding countryside.  The buildings are located in an area of the campus that can be easily and directly accessed from outside the boundaries of the college, while its immediately neighboring location offers access to the college‘s long list of amenities.  Strategically positioned between Ithaca and Cortland with strong demand for housing, the property provides a flexible foundation for a variety of redevelopment paths. This offering caters to local, regional, and national developers, as well as mission-driven investors seeking scale, quality construction, and value-add potential.

The site presents a unique opportunity for large‑scale industrial and commercial development in the heart of Virginia, offering rare, contiguous acreage along the I‑95 Corridor with outstanding regional accessibility. The property comprises 500+ acres, supported by existing 230kV and 115kV transmission lines, providing the reliable, scalable power required for modern manufacturing, logistics, and industrial operations.

Dominion Energy has acquired 10 acres on the western edge of the property to construct the Rollercoaster Substation, which will connect a new solar energy facility to the broader transmission grid and enhance reliability, with completion anticipated in summer 2026.

The acreage includes approximately 189 acres of wetlands or floodplain and 68 acres encompassing the dormitory and campground areas. The property can accommodate a multi‑building campus, offering flexible lot configurations, generous building footprints, outdoor storage potential, and compatibility with numerous industrial and commercial development strategies.

The seller is flexible and will consider offers on all or a portion of the site.
listings.locationDescription:

Its access to major transportation routes, strong visibility, and adjacency to established industrial and commercial infrastructure position the site as a strategic location for future development. Situated in Hanover County, the property benefits from a business‑friendly environment and a local government supportive of economic development and job‑creating investment.

listings.headline: 32 Unit Value Add Opportunity with Redevelopment Potential
listings.description:
CBRE Upstate NY is pleased to offer 2 Fall Street, known as the Lakeview Apartments, in Seneca Falls, New York. This is a unique opportunity to redevelop this property to take advantage of its underutilized waterfront potential. This property operated as a hospital from 1958 to 1978 and now houses 32 residential units. 2 Fall Street consists of roughly 34,000 square feet over three floors and features an updated elevator for tenants’ convenience.
The property offers significant upside potential, including the addition of 12-15 more residential units in the unfinished sections of the building. Dock slips can potentially be installed to allow a buyer to capitalize on the waterfront location. Investors will have the rare benefit of income from the current units while they reposition and redevelop the property for additional units.
Our team will accompany interested parties on property tours. All tours must be requested through, and accompanied by, the CBRE Upstate NY listing team and require a minimum 48 hours advance notice and are subject to schedule availability.
listings.locationDescription:
Seneca Falls is a town in Seneca County, New York, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population was approximately 8,942. The town is located in the northern part of the Finger Lakes region, midway between Rochester and Syracuse, along the shores of the Cayuga–Seneca Canal.
Formally established in 1829, Seneca Falls is often regarded as the birthplace of the women’s rights movement in the United States. It was the site of the historic 1848 Women’s Rights Convention, where the Declaration of Sentiments was signed, marking a pivotal moment in the fight for gender equality.
Historically, Seneca Falls developed as an industrial and transportation center due to its position along the canal system, which connected it to the Erie Canal and major trade routes. Today, it remains a community with a strong mix of manufacturing, tourism, and small business.

listings.headline: A Rust Belt venue booming with rhythm & industrial vibes
listings.description:
The circa-1902 building at 49 Illinois Street in downtown Buffalo was reimagined as a music venue in 2013 and added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2014 for its industrial past, a site where drilling equipment and capital hardware goods were produced for various local industries.

Since then, Buffalo Iron Works’ operator has established itself as a staple in the city’s vibrant entertainment scene featuring local and national touring artists across diverse genres on its 16’x20’ stage. The venue also opens for most events hosted across the street at KeyBank Center, the largest indoor arena in Western New York and home to the NHL’s Buffalo Sabres and NLL’s seven-time league champion Buffalo Bandits.

+ Established, long-term operator in place
+ First floor performance space includes 16’x20’ stage, bar, kitchen, mezzanine seating, and connected outdoor space accessible via two overhead doors
+ Second floor features a mostly open floor plan with office space, storage and greenroom for visiting artists
listings.locationDescription:
Named for its stone-paved streets, the Cobblestone District is a historic industrial neighborhood just south of the central business district that has developed into an entertainment destination home to KeyBank Center, Helium Comedy Club, Seneca Buffalo Creek Casino, Lockhouse Distillery, LECOM Harborcenter, Southern Tier Brewing Company.

Additionally, the redevelopment of the circa-1917 DL&W Railroad Terminal will further activate the neighborhood as a new light rail station for the NFTA is added along with a public market and event space comprised of 80,000 SF indoors and another 40,000 SF outside. Activation of the terminal and programming is anticipated to take place in Spring 2027.
highlights: Fully occupied with an established long-term operator in place on a NNN lease

CBRE is pleased to offer an approximately 14,440 SF aircraft hangar facility for sale or lease at the Youngstown-Warren Regional Airport. This versatile hangar would be an ideal fit for a variety of aviation venues including MROs, aviation-related businesses, and private aircraft storage. The facility includes ample office, lobby, and storage space, and features a private entrance with a fenced-in parking area that provides direct access onto the ramp.

 

Property Highlights:

listings.locationDescription:
The Youngstown-Warren Regional Airport is located in Vienna Township,
Trumbull County, Ohio. This Part 139 certified airport serves as a transportation hub for the Mahoning Valley and surrounding areas, providing general aviation, corporate, military, and commercial services. The airport features three asphalt runways, the longest of which is 9,003 feet. Runway 14 features a Category I ILS (Instrument Landing System), equipped with localizer (LOC), glideslope (GS), and outer/middle marker beacons. Both Runway 14 and Runway 32 are equipped with RNAV (GPS) approaches for more flexible routing and fuel efficiency. Medium Intensity Approach Lighting System with Runway Alignment Indicator Lights (MALSR) is also available for Runway 14. Precision Approach Path Indicators (PAPI) featuring color-coded light arrays help guide pilots during approach and landing. A fully staffed FAA control tower on the airfield is typically operated between 7:00 AM and 11:00 PM local time, and provides services including ground control, local tower control, and clearance delivery. Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) services are onsite at the airport, ensuring safety for all operators.

The site has great connectivity to the 100-mile Towpath trail and 20-acre Irishtown Bend public park project and waterfront revitalization.

BEER BARREL SALOON
Home of the World’s Longest Bar, The Beer Barrel Saloon is one of Put-in-Bay’s most popular attractions providing a lively, friendly atmosphere and top-notch entertainment attractions. The 405-foot bar features an amazing 56 beer taps and 160 bar stools, offering ample space for visitors to enjoy drinks and delicious food. The Beer Barrel hosts live entertainment from April to October and is a favorite spot for tourists and island locals alike.


TIPPERS LOUNGE & RESTAURANT
Located adjacent to Beer Barrel Saloon, Tipper’s is the perfect destination for a delicious meal on the island. Serving up surf and turf in a welcoming environment, Tipper’s is a popular spot offering daily specials and happy hour. This restaurant boasts 5,676 SF of dining and bar area and includes a massive 1,500 SF kitchen.

ISLAND BEVERAGE STORE
The Island Beverage Store is PIB’s one-stop shop for the locals and visitors beverage and snack needs and operates year-round. Located in the heart of the island, just a short stroll from Jose De Rivera Park and the City Boat Docks, it is the perfect pit stop 
for boaters and visitors alike. This store is the go-to place for liquor, beer, wine, other beverages and snacks on the island.

This property is in the City of Cordele and sits at the northeast corner of the Highway 300 interchange across from the Marathon gas station. The site is flat and cleared. With 45,870 vehicles and 14,075 trucks passing the site daily, this property has tons of visibility. State Highway 300 is planned for expansion and extension east to U.S. Highway 280. Site access will exist via two drive cuts along State Highway 300. The site is less than two miles from the Cordele Inland Port. The Cordele Inland Port operated by Cordele Intermodal Services,  provides direct rail access to the Georgia Ports Authority in Savannah, Georgia, moving national and international shipments more efficiently by avoiding any truck congestion at the port. Cargo is transferred directly from railcars to an ocean vessel for export, or from an ocean vessel to railcars for transport and distribution from Cordele.

listings.headline: ±70.5 ac along The Soque River | Clarkesville, GA
listings.locationDescription: ±70.5 acres in Habersham County. This gentleman’s farm has ±1,500 feet of frontage on both sides of the renowned Soque River. This is arguably the best river in Georgia to fish for trophy rainbow and brown trout. Like minded landowners help protect and grow big fish, which benefits the entire fishery. The current landowner has recently completed significant work on the banks of the river while he also creating deep pools with riffles that force oxygen into the river. This work creates an ideal fishing environment as well as ideal habitat for fish to thrive. Well located in a gorgeous valley, this property has multiple graded home locations with stunning views. The new four board fence and electric gate are fitting for this special getaway property and the bridge over the river was designed for heavy trucks to come build your dream mountain lodge. Bleu Canoe is only 2.85 miles away and LaPrade’s Marina is right down the road at 4.9 miles from the property. An easy drive from Atlanta, this is a place to cool off and fish for 30 inch trout that will do their best to break your 6 weight fly rod. Deer and turkey are numerous in the area and someone could easily plant a dove field in the 23 acres of pasture. If you walk to the top of the property, you can keep walking as long as you want in the hundreds of thousands of National Forest acres that abut the land. Access to Lake Burton, Seed, and Rabun are right around the corner as well as golf courses and numerous waterfall hikes. Fortunately, you can also leave your vehicle parked if you want to enjoy a waterfall as there is a beautiful one already on the land. The thriving town of Clayton, GA is only a dozen miles away, which has several great restaurants and shopping opportunities.

listings.locationDescription:
200 Interchange Park Drive is strategically located just off I-75 at Exit 81, one of East Tennessee’s most traveled corridors connecting Knoxville to Chattanooga and beyond. This prime location offers excellent visibility and accessibility for regional traffic and serves as a gateway to Knoxville’s growing metropolitan area.
The property sits within Interchange Park, a professional business hub that attracts healthcare providers, corporate offices, and service industries.
Lenoir City is widely recognized as the “Lake Capital of the South,” offering direct access to the Tennessee River and nearby lakes, including Fort Loudoun and Tellico, which draw thousands of visitors annually for boating, fishing, and outdoor recreation.
Knoxville, located just 25 minutes away, is home to the University of Tennessee and a vibrant downtown featuring dining, entertainment, and cultural attractions. The area also serves as a major route for travelers heading to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park, which welcomed over 13 million visitors in 2023, making it one of the most visited national parks in the United States.
Recent regional growth has been fueled by healthcare expansion, manufacturing investment, and tourism. Lenoir City benefits from proximity to major employers, strong demographics, and easy access to I-40 and I-75, two of the nation’s busiest interstate highways. The surrounding area offers a mix of retail, dining, and hospitality options, supporting both local residentsand visitors.
With its strategic location, professional setting, and connection to East Tennessee’s economic and recreational assets, 200 Interchange Park Drive is an ideal site for medical, office, or service-oriented businesses seeking visibility and convenience in a thriving market.

listings.name: Oakley Station
listings.headline: OFFICE/MEDICAL SITE AVAILABLE FOR SALE OR LEASE
listings.description:
Oakley Station is the 74-acre site where Cincinnati Milling Machine / Cincinnati Milacron once operated and grew to become the world’s largest machine tool company in the 1930s. The company closed in 2003, and had fallen dormant with over 1.6 million square feet of deteriorated and obsolete industrial buildings. After several redevelopment attempts,Vandercar and USS Realty acquired the site in 2011 and with the assistance of the City of Cincinnati and the State of Ohio’s Brownfield Redevelopment Program  completed full demolition and environmental remediation of the property in 2012. 

Today, Oakley Station is a thriving mixed use development in the heart of Cincinnati’s Oakley Neighborhood anchored by Kroger Marketplace, 14-screen Cinemark Theater, The Boulevard at Oakley Station (450 apartment unit development), Anthem Insurance’s Cincinnati offices totaling 80,000 SF, Oakley Greens – 12,000 SF Sports Bar & Grill with 36 minigolf holes, 6 Video Walls and 2 Full Service Bars, 3 Hotels and several additional restaurants and retail options.

listings.locationDescription: Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (IATA: CVG is a public international airport located in Hebron, Kentucky. The airport is a global hub for Amazon Air, Atlas Air, ABX Air, Kalitta Air, Southern Air, and DHL Aviation, handling numerous domestic and international cargo flights every day. Recently, the publication “Air Cargo World” named CVG the top cargo airport in the world. The annual awards are based on the Air Cargo Excellence Survey, which surveys more than 1,700 market participants to determine the top cargo carriers and airports in the world. The awards, established in 2005 by Air Cargo World, are presented annually to the airlines and airports achieving the highest scores in the survey based on several performance factors. CVG’s position as a global cargo leader is important to the region with more than $6.8 billion of total economic impact each year

listings.headline: Redevelopment Investment Opportunity - Louisville, KY
listings.description:
CBRE has been retained as the exclusive representative to offer Gardiner Point, a 142,754 SF 257-room building on 5.29 acres with 341 parking spaces located at 4004 Gardiner Point Drive in Louisville, KY, (the “Property”) for sale to qualified buyers. The building was built in 1965 as the Colonel Sanders Inn adjacent to the KFC/YUM campus, and was expanded, renovated and converted into a residence hall for Sullivan University in 2010.

The building is also equipped with a complete commercial kitchen and restaurant space which would be beneficial for an assisted living use or behavioral/addiction treatment facility. The central location would be appealing to staff, patients and their families coming from within the Louisville market or commuting to the facility. There is also a shortage of affordable housing throughout the city, which could be addressed with this project. In addition, the close proximity to student populations for Sullivan University, Bellarmine University and the University of Louisville and healthcare workers for the downtown medical center and the St. Matthews medical district could represent potential tenants for a multi-family conversion.
listings.locationDescription: The building is conveniently located near the I-264/Newburg Road interchange with great interstate visibility. The central location with access from Louisville’s inner belt (I-264) is a tremendous strength. The Property is in close proximity to the Louisville Muhammad Ali  International Airport, Kentucky Kingdom Theme and Water Park, Churchill Downs, the University of Louisville’s football stadium and the Kentucky Fair and Exposition Center, all of which drive tremendous hotel demand in the area. The saltwater pool, meeting rooms, lakefront setting and traditional architectural style would also appeal to the bourbon tourism community that is visiting Louisville throughout the City.

listings.locationDescription:
Huntsville is one of the Southeast’s most resilient and fast-growing industrial markets, driven by long-term federal investment, defense and aerospace leadership, and a deep technical workforce. As demand accelerates for secure, expandable industrial real estate, large, well-positioned sites are increasingly scarce. The 50-acre Kellner Road SW site offers a rare opportunity to secure scale, access, and long-term flexibility in Huntsville’s southwest growth corridor—where many comparable parcels no longer exist.
Huntsville’s growth trajectory is driven by sustained employer expansion, continued federal funding, and ongoing population inflows drawn by quality of life and career opportunities. Infrastructure investment, workforce development, and business-friendly policies continue to reinforce the region’s appeal for industrial and logistics users. As demand for secure, expandable, and strategically located industrial real estate increases, well-located large-acre sites like this one are becoming harder to replace.

listings.locationDescription:
Situated southwest of downtown, Music Row is home to several businesses and attractions related to the city’s musical heritage. Developed in the 1950s and considered the heart of Nashville’s entertainment industry, the Music Row area is centered on 16th and 17th Avenues South, which are known as Music Square East and West respectively. Points of interest in the district include the historic RCA Studio B, Columbia’s Historic Quonset Hut, the first recording studio on Music Row, and Owen Bradley Park as well as numerous shops and upscale eateries. “Musica,” a large bronze statue designed by Alan LeQuire, is the centerpiece of the Music Row Roundabout. 

The neighborhood first attracted music industry firms after WSM announcer David Cobb referred to Nashville as “Music City, USA” during a broadcast in 1950. As the moniker became widely accepted, the city rapidly grew into one of the nation’s top centers for music recording and publishing. With the signing of Elvis Presley, RCA Victor realized the need for a branch office in the southeast. They chose Nashville and built the historic RCA Studio B, which has played a role in the careers of numerous legendary performers. 

Along with radio stations and networks, the neighborhood is the setting for recording studios, publishing houses, music licensing firms and other organizations like video production houses that serve the music industry. As a result, Music Row is synonymous with the country music industry. The area was once the home of the Country Music Hall of Fame as well as several other smaller museums dedicated to individual stars of the musical genre. After the Hall of Fame moved to its current location in 2001, the museums were replaced with upscale shops, clubs and restaurants.

listings.locationDescription:
NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS
609 S. State Street is situated between the South Loop and the Loop
neighborhoods of Chicago. This is a dynamic urban environment with
a rich mix of cultural attractions, residential developments, student
housing, and convenient transportation.

The neighborhood has a distinct character - the nearby area known as
Printer’s Row is centered around Dearborn Street and was historically
an area of printing, publishing, and related businesses between 1886
and 1915. Many of these historic buildings have since been converted
into residential lofts, contributing to a unique architectural landscape.
The Loop is Chicago’s vibrant central business district, renowned for its
stunning architecture, significant cultural institutions, and bustling urban
energy. Historically a 9-to-5 business hub, the Loop has transformed
into a dynamic residential area, attracting professionals and empty
nesters drawn to its walkability and rich amenities. The South Loop has
undergone a significant rebirth over the last decade, with extensive
redevelopment of buildings, restaurants, parks, and transportation,
blending downtown energy with tranquil waterfront greenery. It is known
for its diverse dining options, from upscale to casual eateries, and a
vibrant cultural scene with museums and art galleries.

This property benefits from close proximity to many of Chicago’s major attractions and green spaces such as: Grant Park, Museum Campus, Lakefront Access, Historic Districts, Soldier Field, the Chicago River, and more.

listings.headline: Absolute Net Leased Dominos
listings.description: CBRE is pleased to offer for sale this single tenant Dominos located on the outskirts of Mobile, AL. The lease is absolute net and will commence at close of escrow. This property has been operating as a Dominos for more than 32 years. The lease allows for three, 5-year options to extend. The property is well served by its visibility from highway 45 traveling directly to Mobile, AL just 6 miles southeast. Its equipped with multiple points of ingress/egress just 2 blocks off the Interstate 65 on/off ramps. The property has a drive thru and is well located within a dense residential area reporting more than 37,000 households within a five mile radius.
listings.locationDescription:
PRICHARD, ALABAMA
Prichard is in the southwest corner of Mobile County, Alabama. It is a part of the Mobile metropolitan area and is a northern industrial suburb of Mobile. Prichard borders the north side of Mobile, as well as the Mobile suburbs of Chickasaw and Saraland. Prichard is intersected by U.S. Highway 43 (north-south), U.S. Highway 45 (northwest-southeast), and Interstate 165; it is less than five miles from Interstate 65 (north-south) and less than 10 miles from Interstate 10 (east-west).

Mobile is a major port and shipbuilding and commercial center at the head of Mobile Bay on the Gulf Coast. Mobile is Alabama’s only saltwater port. The area has grown considerably as a port facility, in part because of the growth of Asian-owned auto plants in Alabama and other parts of the South.

Mobile is the county seat of Mobile County and Mobile & Mobile County has a combined population of 412,000. They are often considered the gateway to the gulf because you can’t get to the beach without traveling through Mobile. Mobile is known for having the oldest organized Carnival or Mardi Gras celebrations in the United States.

Aerospace, steel, ship building, retail, services, construction, medicine, and manufacturing are Mobile’s major industries. AlwaysHD, Foosackly’s, Integrity Media, and Volkert, Inc. are headquartered in Mobile. The Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley is an industrial complex and airport located 3 miles south of the central business district of the city. It is the largest industrial and transportation complex in the region, having more than 70 companies, many of which are aerospace, spread over 1,650 acres. Notable employers at Brookley include Airbus North America Engineering (Airbus Military North America’s facilities are at the Mobile Regional Airport), ST Aerospace Mobile (a division of ST Engineering), and Continental Motors. A new Airbus A320 family aircraft assembly plant opened in Mobile in late 2015 to the tune of $600 million at the Brookley Aeroplex for the assembly of the A319, A320 and A321 aircraft. It covers one million square feet on 53 acres of flat grassland. On October 16, 2017, Airbus announced a partnership with Bombardier Aerospace, taking over a majority share of the Bombardier CSeries airliner program. As a result of this partnership, Airbus plans to open an assembly line for CSeries aircraft in Mobile, particularly to serve the US market. This effort may allow the companies to circumvent high import tariffs on the CSeries family. The aircraft was renamed the Airbus A220 on July 10, 2018. Production started in August 2019.

listings.description:
To view Offering Memorandum, please visit:  https://www.cbredealflow.com/buyer/agreement?pv=SkC_dXoT6TAkPpvgUQGqegQhYeaQTFFgl9WHHh7KIvl9_8DI6TWOCABnJ4xY53OW

CBRE, as exclusive agent, is pleased to present the rare opportunity to purchase Village Green Shopping Center (“the Property”). Located at the signalized intersection of Shermer Road and Meadow Road in Northbrook, IL - one of the most affluent north shore Chicago suburbs - the Village Green Shopping Center is a mixed-use commercial and residential property, home to a diversified and complimentary mix of service based tenants with an average tenure of more than 18 years, a multifamily component comprised of 10 luxury apartments, and a 200-stall parking lot. This asset has been under the same ownership for the last 34 years and is in excellent condition, given ownership’s proactive maintenance program and significant CapEx investment on behalf of tenants and ownership alike.
The Property is the central building in downtown Northbrook on busy Shermer Road, directly across from Village Green Park in the heart of Northbrook's central business district. Village Green Shopping center boasts more than 133,000 annual visitors and average annual incomes exceed $230,000 in a one-mile radius. The Property benefits from superior access as it is steps away from the Metra train station and Pace Bus Route. Village Green Shopping Center’s ideal tenant mix, strong operating history, and excellent real estate fundamentals create a compelling and rarely-available investment opportunity.

listings.locationDescription:
Northbrook is a thriving and affluent suburb located in northern Cook County, Illinois, just 25 miles northwest of Chicago. With a population of over 35,000 residents, Northbrook boasts a median household income of approximately $150,000. The Village is home to a highly educated and well-credentialed workforce, with over 60% of residents holding a bachelor’s degree or higher. Several major corporations have their headquarters or regional offices in or near Northbrook. This includes Allstate Insurance, which is one of the largest employers in the area.  

Northbrook is known as one of the most vibrant communities on Chicago’s North Shore offering endless upscale shopping and dining options with a friendly, neighborhood feel. The Property greatly contributes to that community feeling given its many tenant offerings and ideal location across from Village Green: a lush park known around town as the home of Little League Baseball, Park Fest concerts and other favorite community events. The Village is served by several well-regarded school districts, which add to its appeal as a model suburban community. Moreover, Northbrook benefits from its proximity to major transportation routes, including Interstate 294 and Metra commuter rail, services which are only steps away from the Property.

listings.locationDescription:
Walker’s Point is a mixed-use, urban neighborhood located just south of Milwaukee’s central business district, bounded by the Menomonee River to the north and the Kinnickinnic River to the south. The area spans approximately 1.2 square miles and features a combination of residential, commercial, and light industrial zoning. The neighborhood includes a variety of building types, from historic brick warehouses and
converted lofts to newer office developments and small-scale apartment buildings. Residential units range from studio apartments to multi-bedroom homes, with a significant portion of the housing stock dating back to the early 20th century.

The neighborhood is accessible via major thoroughfares such as South 1st Street and National Avenue, and is served by multiple Milwaukee County Transit System bus routes. Walker’s Point has seen substantial reinvestment in recent years, including the development of multi-tenant office spaces and creative workspaces catering to technology, design, and artisan industries. Amenities in the area include proximity to downtown Milwaukee, access to the riverwalk, and a growing number of restaurants, breweries, and small businesses.

listings.headline: 29,686 SF Building, Fully Leased by Government Tenant with A- S&P Global Credit Rating and 54 Year Tenure
listings.description:
CBRE, Inc. is exclusively representing the sale of 1329 North Lake Street, (“The Property”), a fully leased investment located in the Chicago suburb of Aurora, Illinois. The Property features a single tenant: The State of Illinois Department of Corrections Fox Valley Adult Transition Center which is dedicated to providing support services for women in their successful reintegration into society following incarceration. Since 1972, the Department of Corrections has continuously operated this facility, initially for men only, its purpose was shifted in 2000 to provide services for women. 

The Property features a four-story, ±29,686 square foot brick edifice, accommodating up to 128 female residents in 40 individual dormitory style rooms. It also encompasses administrative offices, alongside areas for counseling, academic initiatives and volunteer efforts. Educational programs offered include adult basic education, GED preparation, and college-level courses. The building is served by 22 surface parking spaces.
Tenant is currently under a gross lease with Tenant paying for utilities, janitorial, snow removal and other operational expenses. The current lease expires October 30, 2030 and Tenant has a five-year option to extend.
The property is situated on the southeast corner of North Lake Street (21,100 avg. vehicles per day) and Sullivan Road (10,500 avg. vehicles per day) and this intersection is regulated by a stoplight.
listings.locationDescription:
The area is highly populated, with approximately 98,659 individuals residing within a three-mile radius. Its proximity to educational institutions, a hospital, retail centers, dining establishments, and various government offices ensures a wealth of entry-level employment prospects.
It is conveniently located next to a Social Security Administration field office and across the street from Prime Healthcare Mercy Medical Center where residents may seek additional services. The Mercy Medical Center just renewed with a long term lease showing their commitment to the area.

CBRE, as exclusive marketing advisor, is pleased to present Whispering Heights Apartments (the "Property"), a well-located multifamily community situated in Edwardsville, Illinois, within the St. Louis MSA. The Property features a mid-rise layout with a balanced mix of apartment homes designed to appeal to a broad renter profile, offering a suburban residential setting with convenient access to employment, education, and retail amenities. All units feature elegant interiors with upscale finishes, delivering a refined and luxurious living experience.

The community is enhanced by amenities including ample parking, green space, and on-site management and maintenance. Whispering Heights' steady occupancy profile positions the Property as a workforce and mid-market housing option within one of the Metro East's most desirable municipalities.

With its attractive location, stable operating fundamentals, and opportunity to further enhance interiors and amenities, Whispering Heights Apartments represents a compelling opportunity to acquire a well-positioned multifamily asset with both current income and long-term upside.
listings.locationDescription: Strategically located in Edwardsville, the Property benefits from proximity to I-270 and Route 159, allowing residents quick access to Downtown St. Louis, major regional employment centers, and surrounding retail corridors. Edwardsville is also home to Southern Illinois University Edwardsville (SIUE), a key demand driver providing long-term rental stability. The area is recognized for its strong demographics, high quality of life, and highly regarded school systems, reinforcing consistent renter demand and future rent growth potential.
highlights: Stabilized multifamily asset in Edwardsville, Illinois, a premier St. Louis Metro East submarket characterized by strong demographics, including a one-mile $106,084 average household income and a one-mile average home value of $370,484, supporting consistent renter demand and long‑term market stability.

Close proximity to major employment drivers including Southern Illinois University Edwardsville (SIUE), regional healthcare systems, and a diverse base of employers throughout Madison County and the greater St. Louis MSA, supporting steady occupancy.
Historically limited new multifamily supply in Edwardsville due to zoning constraints and land scarcity, helping preserve occupancy levels and support ongoing rent growth for existing assets.
Unit layouts appeal to a diverse renter base including SIUE students and faculty, young professionals, and downsizing households, supporting consistent leasing demand and tenant diversification.
Demonstrated stable historical occupancy, currently 91.5%, and reliable rent collections, providing a solid foundation of in‑place cash flow.

Whispering Heights is conveniently located near several major regional highways, including I-64, I-55, and I-255, providing efficient access throughout the Metro East and direct connectivity to downtown St. Louis, Scott Air Force Base, and key employment and education centers across the greater St. Louis MSA.

listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale The Georgian Apartments ("Property"), a premier 74-unit residential building located in the heart of St. Louis, Missouri. Built in 1907 and completely renovated in 2020, The Georgian offers a mix of modern and vintage styles, offering residents the perfect blend of classic architecture and contemporary living. The Georgian Apartments provides an unforgettable living experience with unrivaled views of the bustling city and the serene Mississippi River.

The Property boasts a range of amenities that cater to the modern urban dweller. These include a state-of-the-art fitness center, a resident lounge, a business center, and a rooftop deck that provides panoramic views of the city. 

The apartments are a testament to sophisticated urban living, offering spacious floor plans, modern appliances, and high-end finishes. With a range of one and two-bedroom options, The Georgian Apartments cater to a diverse range of residential needs.

The Georgian offers residents easy access to a host of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. The Property is also conveniently located near major transportation hubs, making daily commuting a breeze. With its blend of luxury, convenience, and prime location, The Georgian Apartments presents an exceptional investment opportunity for potential buyers.
listings.locationDescription:
The beautiful Lafayette Square neighborhood centers on leafy Lafayette Park, a popular setting for concerts and outdoor films, and baseball games played on a vintage-style field. The park is surrounded by stately Victorian townhouses and retail spaces including restaurants, wine bars, and cafes nearby. 

Lafayette Square is a neighborhood in St. Louis, Missouri, which is bounded on the north by Chouteau Avenue, on the south by Interstate 44, on the east by Truman Parkway, and on the west by South Jefferson Avenue. It surrounds Lafayette Park, which is the St. Louis’ oldest public park — created by local ordinance in 1836.

The neighborhood is one of the oldest in St. Louis. When it was developed, it was one of the most fashionable places to live. Since the 1970s, St. Louis residents have been buying and renovating the older homes in Lafayette Square. As of 2006, most of the homes have been restored and there are many shops and restaurants.

In 1972 the city acknowledged, by ordinance, Lafayette Square as its first historic district. In 1973 the U.S. Congress placed Lafayette Square on the National Register of Historic Places. A Historic Code preserves the neighborhood for future generations to see and enjoy.
highlights: PREMIER LOCATION: The Georgian is located in the heart of St. Louis, offering a vibrant and bustling neighborhood that is ideal for both work and play. The property's prime location provides easy access to some of the city's most popular attractions, restaurants, and shopping destinations. It is also conveniently close to major transport links, ensuring residents can easily navigate the city. Nearby are two of the country’s most respected educational institutions, Washington University and Saint Louis University. Highly-regarded Barnes-Jewish Hospital, Washington University Medical Center, Saint Louis University Hospital and the Cortex Innovation Community are also just a short distance from The Georgian.

LIFESTYLE: The Georgian offers a lifestyle of luxury, convenience, and comfort. The residential property features a variety of high-end amenities for its residents, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, a rooftop lounge, a clubhouse, and a pet spa. It also offers concierge services to cater to the needs of its residents. The apartments are designed with a modern and sophisticated aesthetic, offering a comfortable and luxurious living space.

INVESTMENT:  The Georgian is an iconic property in the Lafayette Square neighborhood of St. Louis, Missouri. Lafayette Square is a high barrier to entry market for new construction multifamily product due to limited land availability and high construction costs. With the Property’s irreplaceable location, and limited new supply to compete with it, The Georgian truly offers investors a rare opportunity in the St. Louis market.

ACCELERATING SURROUNDING EMPLOYMENT: The Georgian is situated in a thriving employment hub, with a growing number of businesses and companies establishing their presence in the area. This presents a robust job market for residents, giving them access to a wide range of career opportunities within a short commute from home. The location combines the convenience of urban living with the benefits of a thriving job market.

BEST-IN-CLASS PRODUCT QUALITY: The Georgian is committed to delivering a top-quality product to its residents. The apartments are furnished with high-end appliances and finishes, providing a luxurious living space. The design, construction, and maintenance of the property are all carried out with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that the standards of quality and comfort are consistently met. The Georgian strives to provide a living experience that is exceptional in every way.

listings.description:
West Memphis, with a population of approximately 24,656 people, is a charming small-town just minutes away from the cultural amenities of downtown Memphis. West Memphis is the largest city in Crittenden County, Arkansas. It is part of the Memphis metropolitan area and is located directly across the Mississippi River from Memphis, Tennessee.

Primarily because of its central location and transportation infrastructure, West Memphis has become a hub for distribution and assembly operations. The city lies at the point where two of the nation's most heavily traveled interstate highways, Interstate 40 and Interstate 55, intersect with the Mississippi River (a major cargo waterway) and large rail-lines operated by BNSF and Union Pacific. Major operations include distribution centers for retailers such as Family Dollar, Carvana, Bosch Tools and manufacturers such as Stateside Steel & Wire. Healthcare is also a noteworthy component of the city's economy, including Baptist Memorial Hospital – Crittenden, various clinics, medical suppliers, and nursing homes located in town.

With over 1,200 new jobs in the hospitality, retail and manufacturing sectors and total investments in both public and private facilities topping over half a billion dollars, West Memphis is on a #winning streak. Delaware North, which owns and operates Southland Casino Racing, just completed a $320 million expansion of the West Memphis, Arkansas gaming and entertainment destination in July of 2022 to include a new casino complex and high-rise hotel (opening late 2022). The project allows Southland to expand its gaming offerings to 2,400 gaming machines from the current 2,000 and as many as 60 live table games. The new, 113,000-square-foot casino complex also features new and expanded dining options, including a larger buffet, larger steakhouse restaurant, new food hall, new coffee shop, new player lounge and new center, lobby and steakhouse bars. The signature component of the expansion project is a 20-story hotel tower that features 300 rooms: 216 standard rooms, 72 corner suites and 12 penthouse suites on the top floor. Onsite parking is expanded via construction of a new, covered parking garage with 1,250 spaces.

listings.locationDescription:
Situated in the heart of the St. Louis metropolitan area, Dogtown is a historic district encompassing the neighborhoods of Clayton-Tamm, Franz Park, Hi-Pointe, Cheltenham, and the eastern portion of Ellendale.

The name “Dogtown” dates back to the mid-19th century, when the area was a small but active clay and coal mining community. Miners coined the term to describe the cluster of modest shelters surrounding the mines—often referred to as “doghouses.” This terminology was not unique to St. Louis; similar mining communities across the United States adopted the name “Dogtown” during that era. Although the mining industry declined by the 1930s, its legacy remains visible in the neighborhood’s enduring use of clay and brick materials.

From the 1850s through the 1940s, Dogtown was home to a significant Irish immigrant population, whose cultural influence continues to shape the neighborhood’s identity. Today, Dogtown proudly celebrates its Irish heritage with an annual St. Patrick’s Day parade, attracting thousands of visitors each year to partake in the festivities

listings.name: Inns at St. Albans
listings.headline: Iconic Property Featuring Event Space, Hotel & Restaurant | St. Albans, Missouri
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale The Inns at St. Albans (“Property”), a truly unique and versatile property located in St. Albans, Missouri.  

Situated amidst picturesque rolling hills near the Missouri River, this historic establishment offers a warm and inviting atmosphere. With a range of accommodations and dining options, The Inns at St. Albans is the perfect destination for overnight stays, outdoor weddings, corporate meetings, dining events and private parties. 

The property also features two iconic dining venues – Head’s Store and Old Barn Inn. A staple of the St. Albans community since the late 19th century, historic Head’s Store offers indoor and outdoor dining, snacks and beverages for on-the-go and carryout meals. The Old Barn Inn acts as an event venue with pop-up dining experiences, holiday gatherings and private events including but not limited to corporate parties, rehearsal dinners and bridal luncheons. Indoors, the Old Barn Inn dining room can accommodate parties of 63. The adjacent outdoor pavilion offers seating for 200. 

The Offering includes the following buildings:
+ The Studio Inn + Vineyard
+ Old Barn Inn Cottages
+ Head’s Store
+ The Lodge
+ Links Cottage + International Choux Cooking School
+ Farm House
listings.locationDescription:
St. Albans, Missouri is a charming and historic town located in Franklin County. Known for its picturesque landscapes and tranquil atmosphere, St. Albans offers residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The town is nestled along the banks of the Missouri River, providing stunning views and outdoor recreational opportunities such as hiking, fishing, and boating. 

St. Albans Country Club
One of the main attractions in St. Albans is the Country Club of St. Albans, a premier 36 hole golf club that boasts two championship courses. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round of golf while taking in the scenic beauty of the surrounding countryside. The private member club also offers various amenities such as a clubhouse, dining, swimming pool, pickleball and tennis courts. The Inns at St. Albans enjoys a reciprocal membership allowing its’ guests full access to the many amenities.   

Head’s General Store
Several historic landmarks are located in St. Albans. The Head’s General Store is one of those landmarks. The store has been in continuous operation since its conception in 1892.  A group of St. Albans townspeople felt that a store would be a good addition to their community so built one and then rented it out to different proprietors. The Pfeiffer Family purchased the store in 1915 and operated it as a General Store until 2004 when the proprietress of 61 years, Mae Pfeiffer Head, passed away. Originally known as “St. Albans General Store”, it is on the National Register of Historic Place.  

The Studio Inn
Another historic landmark is “the Studio”, the home of Oscar and Irene Walter Johnson. The home was built in 1917 and designed by the famous architect Theodore Link who designed Union Station and many other prominent St. Louis buildings. Today the Studio is now The Studio Inn and can be rented for special events and meetings. The Johnsons purchased 8400 acres of land in St. Albans and after the death of Oscar, Irene Walter Johnson developed the farm into a very successful dairy operation called St. Albans Farms. Theodore Link also designed the Johnson’s dairy farm stone barn. The St. Albans Farm’s stone barn was placed on the National Register of Historic Places, but unfortunately, due to extensive deterioration, the building was razed and only the two round stone towers of the barn remain. 

Honey Bee Point
A historic point of reference is Honey Bee Point, located on the bluffs above the Missouri River.  It is on this bluff that Meriwether Lewis claims that he almost fell to his death at the start of the Lewis & Clark Expedition, escaping tragedy by digging his knife sheath into the craggy bluffs before he fell to the bottom.  These cliffs overlook Lake St. Albans today.

listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to present qualified investors the opportunity to acquire the AutoZone located in Minneapolis, MN. This single story 10,886 square foot build-to-suit facility was constructed in 2021 and is located on a .75-acre urban infill site. AutoZone has occupied this signalized corner since 2011. In 2021 they rebuilt the building and committed to a long term 15-year lease. AutoZone, Inc. is the leading retailer and distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories in the United States. The company operates a network of over 7,000 stores across the U.S., Mexico, Puerto Rico, Brazil, and other international markets. AutoZone primarily serves DIY (do-it-yourself) customers, commercial businesses (mechanics and repair shops), and professional installers through its commercial sales program. In 2024, AutoZone reported revenues of $18.49 Billion which represented a growth of 5.92% compared to 2023. The company is publicly traded (AZO) and currently has an investment grade credit rating of BBB (S&P). 


Minneapolis-St. Paul, collectively referred to as the Twin Cities, is the nation’s 16th largest MSA with approximately 3.6 million residents in a 13-county area. It ranks #1 in fortune 500 companies per million people. The stability and growth of large corporate employers has been complemented by a dynamic small business sector. Over 500,000 people live within a 5-mile radius of the AutoZone site. The location is shadow anchored by major big box retail traffic drivers like Target, Cub Foods and Aldi.


With 11 years of lease term remaining, the Minneapolis AutoZone provides steady in-place income with significant 10% rent increases every five years. This income stream is guaranteed by an investment grade credit tenant adding further stability to future cashflow. AutoZone has demonstrated their commitment to this location by rebuilding the facility in 2021 and executing a long term 15-year lease. This site is strategically positioned to meet the increasing demand for Auto Parts in a densely populated trade area.

listings.name: Petco
listings.headline: For Sale: Petco Fridley, MN | 10-Year Lease Extension | Ranked #3 Petco in MN (Placer.ai) | Target Shadow-Anchor | Vetco Total Care Animal Hospital Location
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale the Petco located in Fridley, Minnesota. The property consists of a 15,240-square-foot retail building situated on 1.97 acres at the highly visible intersection of Interstate 694 and Central Avenue (Highway 65). This prominent retail corridor benefits from combined traffic counts exceeding 160,000 vehicles per day, providing exceptional visibility and accessibility.

The subject property is shadow-anchored by Target and benefits from its proximity to Medtronic’s operational headquarters located immediately north of Interstate 694. The adjacent Target was recently selected as one of twenty-eight Twin Cities locations identified by Target Corporation for a significant store remodel, reflecting the retailer’s long-term confidence in the strength of the trade area. The Fridley Target features expanded grocery offerings, pharmacy services, and ranks #14 out of approximately 70 Minnesota locations for site visits according to Placer.ai.

Petco originally executed a fourteen-year lease in 2005 and has demonstrated continued commitment to the location through multiple early lease extensions and option renewals. Most recently, the tenant executed a new ten-year lease extension in 2025. As part of this extension, Petco selected the Fridley location for its Vetco Total Care Animal Hospital program, a full-service veterinary concept integrated within select Petco stores. The comprehensive care offered includes but is not limited to diagnostics, surgery, and dentistry. The Fridley store is one of only four locations in Minnesota selected for the Vetco Total Care model. To support the program, Petco completed a significant interior and exterior renovation at its own expense, further demonstrating its long-term investment in the location. The Fridley store also exhibits strong unit-level performance, currently ranking as the #3 Petco location in Minnesota for site visits according to Placer.ai.

The lease structure is NNN (landlord responsible for building and roof structure (excluding roof membrane)), providing for minimal landlord responsibilities, and features attractive 10 percent rental increases in year six of the remaining base term and within each option period. Petco operates more than 1,400+ locations nationwide and is widely recognized as one of the leading pet specialty retailers in the United States.

The property is located in the City of Fridley, approximately ten miles north of downtown Minneapolis. Fridley is home to more than 30,000 residents and benefits from a strong employment base anchored by major corporate campuses and manufacturing facilities including Medtronic, Cummins, and BAE Systems.
listings.locationDescription:
Sitting in Anoka County as a member of the Twin Cities metropolitan area, Fridley, Minnesota is an inner ring suburb on the north side of Minneapolis. As an immediately adjacent suburb, Fridley is a convenient choice for commuters into either Minneapolis, St.Paul, or the other surrounding suburbs. The city enjoys a robust range of transportation options thanks to major Interstate 694 and Minnesota State Highway 47 and 65. The Northstar Commuter Rail also offers a station in Fridley with service into and out of the heart of Minneapolis.

In 2001, the world’s largest medical device company, Medtronic, opened its world headquarters in Fridley. Today, the campus remains as the company’s operational headquarters. Other major employers in the city include BAE Systems, Cummins, Minco Products, Inc., and a Target retail distribution center, among others.

listings.name: Seventh Street Brownstones
listings.headline: CBRE is pleased to offer for sale Seventh Street Brownstones, a 29-unit townhome community located at 325 SW 7th Street in Downtown Des Moines, Iowa.
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to offer for sale Seventh Street Brownstones, a 29-unit townhome community located at 325 SW 7th Street in Downtown Des Moines, Iowa. Completed in 2013, the property represents a rare opportunity to acquire a boutique portfolio of modern townhomes intentionally designed and finished to for sale standards, offering investors multiple exit strategies including selling units individually or continued operation as a stabilized rental community. 

Seventh Street Brownstones features 29 three bedroom / two-and-a-half-bathroom residences averaging 1,559 square feet, each with two car attached garages and private rooftop patios, a highly differentiated amenity set that closely aligns with urban homebuyer preferences. The property’s uniform unit mix, efficient layouts, and premium finishes position it favorably for a streamlined and repeatable individual sales execution. Importantly, recent individual unit sales ranging from $300,000 to $365,900 demonstrates established buyer demand and validates the property’s embedded individual value premium.

Located in the heart of Downtown Des Moines, the property is steps from the Historic Court District, Downtown Farmer’s Market, and the metro’s primary employment and entertainment nodes, providing a true urban ownership lifestyle with limited competitive supply. With strong in place rental income, minimal near term capital requirements, and proven for sale liquidity, Seventh Street Brownstones offers investors downside protection through cash flow while preserving significant upside by selling units individually.

listings.description:
The offering consists of a three-story mixed-use property with 12,327 square feet of main floor retail and 69 beds of student housing. The asset is strategically located one block from Minnesota State University Mankato. MSU is Minnesota’s second largest university with enrollment exceeding 14,000 students located on a 300+ acre campus. The city of Mankato is 80 miles south of Minneapolis and has a population of 45,000 residents.Lofts@1633 is a three-story mixed-use property with 12,327 square feet of main floor retail and 69 beds of student housing. Qdoba and Subway anchor the retail rent roll that consists solely of service-based retailers. The student housing units include expansive bedrooms with spacious closets and multiple bathrooms. Apartments have an open kitchen design with a center island and tabletop bar. All units come with a full kitchen appliance set, in unit washer & dryer, air conditioning, and free high speed wireless internet. The asset is strategically located one block from Minnesota State University Mankato.

Lofts@1633 has had a consistent track record of 100% occupancy throughout its 69 student housing beds. Student rents at Lofts@1633 have averaged 9% annual compounding growth for the last 5 rental seasons. The retail rent roll consists of a diverse mix of national, regional, and local service-based retailers. The majority of retail rents are significantly below new construction competition resulting in high tenant demand and strong occupancy fundamentals for a new owner.

This offering delivers stable in-place cash flow while also providing the opportunity for significant upside potential. An investor can realize this upside by filling the existing retail vacancy and capitalizing on the student housing rent growth that has been demonstrated with this asset. Value creation will be driven largely by the opportunity to increase cashflows and through the irreplaceable infill location less than one block from the MSU Campus.

listings.description:
CBRE Is pleased to exclusively present for sale the Sherwin-Williams located in Muskogee, OK. The opportunity includes a corporately guaranteed investment grade credit lease with Sherwin-Williams (S&P BBB). Sherwin-Williams has occupied this property since it was built in 1993 and has over 11 years of lease term remaining at a 6.73% average CAP rate. The tenant has demonstrated their commitment to this location by exercising multiple options and most recently signing an early 10-year lease extension. Sherwin-Williams (NYSE: SHW) is a publicly traded company with a current market cap over $86 Billion. They operate in over 120 countries and as of 2024 were the largest coatings company in the world by revenue. In addition to the 6,000 square foot building, this property has additional income generated from a billboard located on the premises. The lease with Clear Channel Outdoor, Inc is based on a percentage of revenue from the billboard and offers a new owner upside potential through future income growth. The Seller has recently invested significant capital expenditures into the property for the benefit of a new owner, including a new roof in 2025 (with transferable warranty) and several upgrades to the parking lot. 

This Sherwin-Williams is centrally located in Muskogee, OK. Muskogee has secured the top position in Oklahoma for capital investment in 2024, ranking #1 in the state with over $4.1 billion in announced projects, according to the Oklahoma Department of Commerce’s New Growth and Expansions Report.
listings.locationDescription:
Muskogee is the 13th-largest city in Oklahoma and is the county seat of Muskogee County. Home to Bacone College, it lies approximately 48 miles southeast of Tulsa.

Muskogee, Oklahoma, boasts a prime location that serves as a hub for business and leisure alike. Nestled in the heart of Green Country, Muskogee is conveniently positioned near major transportation routes, including U.S. Highways 69 and 62, facilitating seamless travel to neighboring cities like Tulsa and Fort Smith, as well as easy access to regional markets. This strategic placement not only supports local commerce but also attracts tourists eager to explore the area’s rich cultural heritage and natural beauty. 

Muskogee is renowned for its historical significance and vibrant community spirit, featuring attractions such as the Five Civilized Tribes Museum and the annual Azalea Festival, which showcase the city’s unique cultural tapestry. The picturesque landscape surrounding Muskogee, with its lush parks and the scenic Arkansas River, provides ample opportunities for outdoor recreation, from fishing and boating to hiking and biking. Furthermore, the city’s commitment to economic development and community improvement ensures that Muskogee remains a thriving place to live, work, and visit. With a blend of accessibility, cultural richness, and natural beauty, Muskogee stands out as a key location in Oklahoma’s diverse landscape.
