listings.locationDescription:
Nestled against the eastern foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains, Azusa, California is aptly nicknamed “The Canyon City.”  The San Gabriel River flanks the city to the west, while the dramatic peaks of the range rise to the north.  This foothill location provides stunning scenery and access to recreational opportunities in the San Gabriel Canyon.  The city itself is relatively compact, so sprawled across just under 10 square miles, with most of its area being land.  Interestingly, historic Route 66 winds its way through Azusa on Foothill Boulevard and Alosta Avenue, adding a touch of nostalgia to the city’s geography.

The San Gabriel Valley and Los Angeles County enjoy a robust and multifaceted economy.  A strong emphasis on education, with Caltech at the forefront, fuels innovation and attracts a skilled workforce. Healthcare is another major player, with numerous hospitals and medical facilities throughout the region. Manufacturing also holds a significant role, particularly in the City of Industry, a major industrial hub. Tourism thrives thanks to the region’s natural beauty and proximity to Los Angeles.  Technology is a growing sector, further diversifying the economic landscape.  International trade flourishes, especially with Pacific Rim nations, fueled by the area’s substantial Asian population and strong foreign investment. This diverse economic engine, coupled with excellent transportation infrastructure that connects the Valley to major ports and beyond, positions San Gabriel Valley for continued growth and prosperity.

Azusa boasts a diverse economy with a strong presence of manufacturing and distribution companies. These businesses provide a significant number of jobs for the city’s residents.  However, Azusa also fosters a growing professional sector, attracting various employers. This mix contributes to a stable economic base.  The retail sector in Azusa complements this by catering to both residents and visitors. Along with national chains, locally owned shops and eateries add vibrancy to the commercial landscape, further solidifying Azusa’s economic well-being.

Beyond its economic offerings, the San Gabriel Valley boasts a wealth of recreational activities and entertainment options. Hikers and nature enthusiasts can explore the scenic trails of the San Gabriel Mountains, while art lovers can visit the Norton Simon Museum or Pasadena Playhouse. Families can enjoy amusement parks like Knott’s Berry Farm or Raging Waters. Additionally, numerous parks, community centers, and golf courses provide opportunities for leisure and socializing.

listings.description:
In 1971, the Crocker Bank Building was erected in Downtown Santa Ana at the corner of North Main Street and Washington Blvd. Built in the
contemporary style of modern functionalism, the building hosted a range of office tenants from public and private entities for most of its lifespan to date.
Current ownership is prepared to deliver the property vacant and free and clear of any encumbrances easing the eventual conversion construction
process. The building itself is constructed of a smooth painted concrete exterior with a flat built-up composition roof. Three elevators serve all nine
stories along with two interior stairways and at least two restrooms per floor. Current build outs range from completely vacant floors with no demising
walls to others finished with drywall partitions in a traditional office layout. The building’s open floor plates are extremely conducive to residential
conversion with limited obstructions and thirteen vertical columns running lengthwise (north/south) down the center of the structure. Fire protection
systems include a dry standpipe and hoses; the building is not equipped with a fire sprinkler system. A small, enclosed utility structure sits on the roof,
housing HVAC, water heater, elevator room and other equipment, accessible by the north interior stairway. Immediately to the west and on the same
parcel as the building sits the property’s own two-story parking garage. At grade with one level above, the garage provides approximately 271 parking
spaces and is accessible by curb-cuts on North Main and Sycamore Streets. Additionally, a parking license agreement exists with the ownership of 812
North Sycamore Street conveying the use of 100 parking spaces immediately across the street from the subject to the west. This 30-year agreement
expires in January of 2037 with multiple options for the Licensee (1200 N. Main St. owner) to extend. An as-built set of floor plans completed by a
licensed architect in 2007 calculates the total gross building area as 152,705 sf.

Orange County, nicknamed the OC, is a county in the southwest region of California. Positioned between the Los Angeles and San Diego metro areas, Orange County is the smallest county in Southern California by square footage but is the third most populated county in the state and the six most in the nation. metropolitan areas but is also equally close to the Inland Empire’s Riverside-San Bernardino metro region.

The San Gabriel Valley, located in eastern Los Angeles County, is a premier region in Southern California spanning 385 square miles across 31 diverse cities. If it were a county, the Valley would be the seventh largest in California, serving as a vital home to over 1.5 million residents. The City of San Gabriel itself was incorporated in 1913, though its roots trace back to 1771 with the founding of the Mission San Gabriel Arcángel. Known as the "Birthplace of the Los Angeles Region," the city serves as a historical cornerstone with numerous nationally registered historic sites, including the Mission Playhouse. It offers a rich cultural tapestry of theaters, festivals, and world-class dining, particularly within its vibrant Asian and Hispanic communities. Located just 11 miles east of downtown Los Angeles, San Gabriel is a central hub for heritage tourism and regional commerce.

San Gabriel remains a highly attractive market for investors due to its stability and specialized economy. While the San Gabriel Valley’s industrial and retail sectors are massive engines of growth, the City of San Gabriel is specifically recognized as a repeat finalist for the "Most Business-Friendly City" in LA County. Recent data shows the local real estate market remains resilient, with a total regional payroll growing to over $22 billion. In 2026, the strongest employment gains have been seen in professional business services and hospitality. With a strategic focus on mixed-use development and private investment, San Gabriel continues to provide a robust environment for businesses and residents alike.

The San Gabriel Valley, encompassing eastern Los Angeles County, maintains a robust network of industry clusters that drive significant investment and job growth. The City of San Gabriel is committed to building strategic partnerships for sustainable, resilient economic development through strategies to stimulate a favorable investment climate, welcome entrepreneurship, encourage industry and talent diversity, expand high-quality jobs and support a unique quality of place. listings.description:
CBRE, is pleased to present this exceptional owner/user opportunity to acquire 489 E. Colorado Boulevard, commonly referred to as the “Harry FitzGerald” building in the heart of the Playhouse Historic District of Pasadena, CA. 

This elegant two-story office building totals approximately 7,774 square feet and is located on north side of the iconic Rose Parade route of Colorado Boulevard. Boasting a healthy “WalkScore” of 97 (‘Walkers Paradise’), the Property offers convenient access to abundant surrounding retail amenities and public transportation. CBRE is pleased to offer for sale the Ice Lakes Lodge and neighboring development land (the “Site” or “Property”). This outstanding lakefront property features a private beach and luxury accommodations on Donner Summit in the Sierra Nevada mountain range.

The Lodge was originally constructed in the 1940s as Serene Lakes Lodge and was then later demolished and rebuilt in 1999 as a full service restaurant and bar with 26 rooms in the European Alpine chalet style the property is today. The property was named Ice Lakes Lodge to pay homage to a company that used to send ice from Serene Lakes to San Francisco for high society to chill their Scotch. In 2014, the current owners undertook a comprehensive redevelopment that was completed in 2020. They converted the property into four luxury lakefront residencies, all with access to the private beach that spans 500 lineal feet of waterfront and with new decks that were installed during the renovation.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a property of such high standards with a private beach in Serene Lakes on Donner Summit and within close proximity to Lake Tahoe. The property provides room for expansion and flexible zoning that allows for both residential and hospitality use, adding to the uniqueness of this opportunity and possibilities available to be explored by a new owner for expansion or conversion to an operating business.

The area is also surrounded by thousands of luxury condominiums and apartment homes, creating a dense and affluent residential base.

The neighborhood is further enriched by its proximity to major educational institutions such as the University of Southern California (USC), UCLA, Cal State Los Angeles, FIDM (Fashion Institute of Design & Merchandising), and Arizona State University. This diverse academic presence contributes to a dynamic and youthful demographic, ideal for a wide range of commercial ventures.

South Park is experiencing a strong post-pandemic recovery, with renewed investment and development activity. Notably, the LA2028 Olympic team has secured significant office space in the area as preparations for the Summer Games ramp up. Just blocks away, the Broadway corridor offers a vibrant retail experience with flagship stores like the Apple Store in the historic Tower Theatre, Adidas Originals, Nike Jump, and Urban Outfitters.

listings.description: Avion Burbank is a strategically located 60-acre, 17-building, mixed-use campus featuring state-of-the-art construction in a collaborative community with multi-purpose paths, outdoor gathering space, and recreational activities. Inspired by such iconic figures in aviation as Amelia Earhart and Lockheed Aircraft Chief Research Engineer Clarence L. "Kelly" Johnson, Avion Burbank represents the value of creativity and innovation through cutting-edge designs by Gensler and HPA. Avion Burbank will consist of six Creative Industrial buildings, nine two-story Creative Office buildings, a 150-room upscale hotel, and approximately 15,000 square feet of retail at the gateway. The Creative Office buildings offer the rare opportunity to purchase or lease, and will feature plug-and-play open areas ideal for meetings and group collaboration. The hotel will feature a business center, fitness center, swimming pool, conference facilities, and a restaurant, providing the offices with all the amenities needed for meeting and hosting guests. The Creative Industrial buildings are on fully secured yards with 8-foot wrought iron fences and will include build-to-suit office space. These buildings will have 30- to 32-foot clear heights, 50- by 52-foot column spacing, and 124'1"- to 135' truck courts. They will also feature ESFR sprinkler systems, 2,000 to 3,000 amps of power, and electric vehicle charging stations. The retail buildings in Avion Burbank will be at the signalized intersection of Tulare Avenue and N Hollywood Way, allowing for easy access and convenient parking for customers. The open-air plaza will offer outdoor patios with dining areas and abundant green spaces. Avion Burbank reflects the City of Burbank's unique place in aerospace history as the site of extraordinary achievements in aircraft design, engineering, and manufacturing. Avion Burbank's pedestrian-friendly facilities and work/lifestyle amenities attract and retain a skilled and motivated employee base — supporting productivity and performance. Twelve miles northeast of Los Angeles, Avion Burbank is between the Hollywood Burbank Airport and Interstate 5/Golden State Freeway, just a quarter-mile to the on- and off-ramps for Interstate 5 and adjacent to the Antelope Valley Metrolink Station. Avion Burbank offers unparalleled access to all modes of transportation, and the support of a progressive and business-friendly city government focused on thoughtful, creative development that will benefit not only business but also the entire Burbank community.

listings.name: MODAA by SPF:a
listings.headline: MODAA by SPF:architects Bespoke LIVE/WORK LOFTS over Premier RETAIL/DINING/GALLERY/OFFICE
listings.description:
"MODAA was originally developed by SPF:a in 2007, designed to capture the flavor of the city’s 1920s art deco origin without conforming to the historic style. The façade, which has been designated by Los Angeles’ Cultural Affairs Commission as “Architecture as Art,” explores the variation, movement, velocity, and tempo of the city on all scales.



As the building is sited exactly on the transition line between The Helms Bakery District and Culver City’s less developed eastern corridor, MODAA stands as a visual representation of the old and new of Culver City, and provides a gateway to its burgeoning arts and design scene.



Materially, the façade features an arrangement of black and white Nordic Cement Panels that protrude at various depths. On the surface, the treatment creates a dynamic visual exchange with the street, but functionally serves as a rain screen, adds insulation, and acts as an acoustic diffuser to Culver City’s main artery.



MODAA’s ground floor currently houses SPF:a’s studio, a global modeling agency, and an art gallery. The second-floor houses, currently, seven live/work, 2-story lofts featuring 16-foot ceilings, individual mezzanines, and glass sliding doors on the southern wall; these units are currently used as a co-working space/incubator." 


-world-architects.com





"The facade of the SPF:a office headquarters and MODAA Lofts explores the relationship between art and architecture. The facade design was approved by the City under "Architecture as Art" in fulfillment of the public art requirement for this live/work development project.


SPF:a is only the second design firm to receive an "Architecture as Art" designation since 1995. Constructed of cement fiberboard panels, the facade of the building acts as a rain screen and shading system.



The panels themselves, which vary in size, relief, and positioning are supposed to reflect the activities within the building.

The floating membrane, which also serves a functional purpose, is designed to articulate the passage of time and represent a musical metaphor.


Founded in 1988, Studio Pali Fekete Architects (SPF:a) has completed projects ranging in size and scope from 5,500 square foot private homes to the 300,000 square foot Getty Villa Museum renovation."



-culvercity.org
highlights: “Architecture as Art”. Bespoke Construction by world famous architects, SPF:a
2007-built Trophy for Investor or Owner/User. Excellent Culver location only blocks to Helms Bakery District.
Eight 2 Bed/1 Bath Loft-Style Units across the top, 15K sq. ft. Office/Retail/Dining on the ground floor, 15K sq. ft.
Most tenants are MTM or on short-term leases. Immediate upside opportunity.

listings.headline: 15 Property Portfolio in North Los Angeles
listings.description:
The Boyett Team at CBRE is pleased to present a rare 15‑property, 548‑unit multifamily portfolio spanning some of Greater Los Angeles’ most consistently high‑demand rental submarkets — including Eagle Rock, West Hills, Northridge, Reseda, Castaic, and multiple pockets of Santa Clarita. Together, the assets form a uniquely diversified yet operationally aligned collection of well‑maintained properties that combine scale, stability, and meaningful rental upside across supply‑constrained neighborhoods.

Across the portfolio, long‑term ownership, consistent historical performance, and strong in‑place occupancy provide an exceptional foundation for revenue durability. With construction years ranging primarily from the late 1970s through early 1990s, every property in the collection benefits from exemption from the Los Angeles RSO and, excluding Castaic (RSTPO), instead operates under AB 1482 (5% + CPI)* — allowing predictable rent growth and streamlined operational consistency across all assets.

A unifying theme across the offering is clear and measurable rental upside, generally ranging from ~8% to as high as ~28% depending on submarket. Every property participates in a RUBS program*, and many generate supplemental parking income, reinforcing expense recovery and supporting strong operating margins. Across the entire collection, repositioning opportunities exist through unit‑turnover upgrades, operational optimization, and strategic enhancement of amenity offerings.

*Buyer to verify

listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to exclusively present for sale 18618 Oxnard Street, an Owner User/Redevelopment campus located in Tarzana and in the heart of the San Fernando Valley, California. The site consists of one (1), two-story creative office building measuring approximately 46,128 SF total, situated on 1.51 acres of land.

In terms of location, Tarzana and the San Fernando Valley as a whole are some of the most demanded and desirable markets in Southern California when considering the single digit vacancy rate, high barriers to entry, property values, and ease of transportation. As for residents, many enjoy the plentiful restaurants, historic monuments, recreational activities, cultural diversity, educational facilities, and the overall quality of life that the San Fernando Valley provides. The site is also situated across the street from the Reseda Orange Metro Line Station. 

As a Redevelopment opportunity, the site has a mixed zoning of M1 (limited industrial), (Q) RM1 (Restricted Industrial) and (P) Automobile Parking, on a rectangular parcel. The property is also eligible for Transit Oriented Communities (TOC), Affordable Housing Incentive Program, Tier 2, Allowing up to 60% bonus density. 

The current owner of the property is Columbia College Hollywood, a non-profit renowned film college. The college will require a short-term Sale Leaseback upon close of Escrow. The exact terms are to be negotiated with the potential purchasers. 

Please DO NOT disturb Columbia College Hollywood for any reason. The sale is for the REAL ESTATE ONLY, not the college.

listings.headline: Prime Santa Monica Multifamily | Six Blocks to Ocean
listings.description:
​​​CBRE is pleased to exclusively present 522–532 Idaho Avenue, a boutique six‑unit multifamily investment opportunity in Santa Monica’s coveted Wilshire‑Montana neighborhood. Located one block south of Montana Avenue and six blocks from Palisades Park and the beach, the property offers premier walkability with low operational complexity—well suited for private buyers seeking an A+ location with stable income and meaningful upside.

Offered at $2,700,000, the property delivers a 4.97% CAP on scheduled income assuming self‑management, or 4.62% CAP with third‑party management in place. Scheduled income reflects a 13.78 GRM, while a pro‑forma GRM of 11.89 highlights the ability to grow revenue over time as legacy tenancies turn.

The property will be delivered with three vacant units (50%), offering a clear path for immediate renovation, customization, and lease‑up at market rents. This gives a buyer the ability to set the tone and finish level from day one, rather than working around existing tenants. In addition, the front yard will be delivered vacant and un-utilized, creating an opportunity to upgrade the exterior—whether through new landscaping, private outdoor areas, or a more defined entry. Combined, these vacancies provide meaningful control over both the unit interiors and the overall presentation of the property, supporting a cohesive upgrade plan and future rent growth.

Built in 1922, the property consists of six one‑bedroom, one‑bathroom bungalow-style units totaling approximately 3,360 SF on a 7,480 SF corner lot. Zoned SMR2, the site benefits from legal non‑conforming density. Two units (526 and 530) have been upgraded with modern kitchens and baths, new flooring, in‑unit washer/dryers, and custom closets. Exterior improvements include new landscaping, fencing, irrigation, and fresh paint.

With walkable access to Montana Avenue, Downtown Santa Monica, and the coastline, along with convenient connectivity to PCH and the I‑10, 522–532 Idaho Avenue represents a rare opportunity to acquire a well-located, easily managed asset with upside in one of Santa Monica’s most desirable neighborhoods.

listings.name: Ocean Santa Monica Apartments
listings.headline: Court-Ordered Receivership Sale | 100 Feet of Ocean Avenue Frontage | Santa Monica | 28 Units
listings.description:
On behalf of Douglas P. Wilson, Court Appointed Receiver, CBRE is pleased to exclusively present Ocean Santa Monica Apartments, a generational opportunity to acquire a coastal bluff asset along one of the most tightly held stretches of Ocean Avenue in Santa Monica.  Positioned between Montana Avenue and Wilshire Boulevard, 901 Ocean Avenue commands sweeping Pacific Ocean and Santa Monica Mountain views from the majority of the units, with all west-facing residences enjoying full, unobstructed ocean exposure and numerous additional units capturing direct water views.

Ocean Avenue north of Wilshire is defined by long-term ownership and limited multifamily inventory.  Apartment assets along this corridor rarely trade, reinforcing the enduring scarcity of the location. Situated on an expansive ±15,011 square foot double lot and encompassing approximately ±30,954 square feet of improvements, the scale, frontage, and bluff-top positioning create a coastal offering that is increasingly difficult to replicate under today’s regulatory and development constraints.

Originally constructed in 1961 and 1970 and comprehensively renovated in 2015, 2021, and 2022, the 28-unit property features 18 one-bedroom/one-bathroom units and 10 two-bedroom/two-bathroom units.  The residences are notably spacious relative to newer coastal product, allowing flexibility for continued interior enhancement at a higher finish level.  Most units offer ocean views, and most residences include more than one private balcony, providing meaningful outdoor space that is highly valued by Santa Monica renters.

The building has been carefully maintained, including updated electrical systems and copper plumbing.  Common area laundry rooms are located on each floor and are currently not operated for additional income.  One unit is equipped with in-unit laundry, and a future owner may consider a coordinated upgrade program incorporating in-unit washer and dryer installations alongside further interior refinements to strengthen positioning within the submarket.

The property is achieving strong in-place rents, reflecting prior capital improvements and sustained coastal demand.  Based on current market conditions, in-place rents across the building present approximately ±20 percent upside without assuming additional renovation.  Under Santa Monica Rent Control, rents may be reset to market upon vacancy and thereafter are subject to allowable annual increases.  This structure provides a measured path to revenue growth through natural turnover, with additional potential available through strategic interior upgrades.  Select furnished units have achieved premium rents, demonstrating further optionality without reliance on aggressive underwriting assumptions.

The property is supported by controlled access entry, gated garage parking with 33 spaces, a rooftop ocean-view deck, pool and common gathering areas, elevator service, and a glass-enclosed entry sitting room that creates a strong first impression upon arrival.  These features, combined with the property’s scale and ocean frontage, support durable tenant demand and long-term stability.

Steps from Palisades Park Providing Open Green Space and Unobstructed Oceanfront Surrounding
Walking Distance to the Pacific Ocean Including Santa Monica State Beach, Jonathan Club, and Annenberg Community Beach House

listings.description: CBRE, Inc., as exclusive agent, is pleased to present for sale a ±5.48-acre reposition opportunity located on the beautiful Southern California Coast in Santa Paula, California. The City of Santa Paula, just minutes from Ventura and Oxnard, is located approximately 70 miles northwest of downtown Los Angeles, and 35 miles west of Santa Clarita. The city of Santa Paula is one of the most dynamic cities in the county with strong support for new developments such as the 2,050 home, 500-acre, The Harvest at Limoneira project as well as the 94.5-acre East Area Gateway Project.
listings.locationDescription:
Located in Santa Paula just yards from The Harvest at Limoneira project, the Property has easy access to Hwy 126 which connects Ventura, Santa Paula, Fillmore and Santa Clarita. Surrounded by the enormous Los Padres National Forest and minutes from the Ventura Harbor and the Channel Islands National Park, Santa Paula offers a scenic, yet affordable, quality of life. 

The City of Santa Paula, California is located 65 miles northwest of Los Angeles, 14 miles east of Ventura and the coastline of the Pacific Ocean, and just 30 miles west of the rapidly growing city of Valencia. Santa Paula is the geographical center of Ventura County, situated in the rich agricultural Santa Clara River Valley. The City is surrounded by rolling hills and rugged mountain peaks in addition to orange, lemon and avocado groves. Santa Paula is referred to as the “Citrus Capital of the World.” The community has a quaint, small town image, ideal climate and reasonably priced housing. Santa Paula maintains its own identity and is in close proximity to the many tourist, recreational, and cultural activities that abound in Southern California.

Rare opportunity to acquire a sizable ±5.48-acre development site

listings.name: 126 Grove Street
listings.headline: Freestanding Building in Old Town Roseville
listings.description: 126 Grove Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a renovated commercial property in the heart of Old Town Roseville. Originally constructed in 1920 as a single-family residence, this 1,228 SF building has been thoughtfully updated and repositioned for modern office and commercial use, while preserving the charm and character of the historic neighborhood. The property sits on a 4,032 SF parcel. The interior features six rooms, including three bedroom-sized offices, two bathrooms, and a full kitchen, offering a flexible layout suitable for office, professional services, or small-scale commercial users. Additional highlights include a large, fully paved backyard with a children's playground, garden area, and a detached storage garage providing valuable on-site storage. The property is currently occupied by an established commercial tenant, Mrs. Z's Busy Bees, an education center dedicated to early childhood learning - providing immediate income for an investor buyer.
listings.locationDescription: The property is located within Old Town Roseville, a stone's throw from Old Town Pizza and Vernon Street's many popular restaurants, coffee shops, and nightlife. With the City of Roseville's Downtown Specific Plan, the property benefits from a forward-looking framework designed to encourage economic vitality, mixed-use activity, and adaptive reuse. The district has attracted new investment and development, including nearby Belvedere, an 18 home luxury townhome community on Lincoln Street, marking the first new ownership housing in Old Town in decades and signaling strong demand for higher end residential uses alongside expanding retail, restaurant, and commercial activity. Owning commercial property, like 126 Grove Street in the Downtown Specific Plan area, offers enhanced flexibility for commercial uses, streamlined approval processes, reduced parking requirements, and design standards that support existing structures and neighborhood-compatible businesses. Businesses benefit from strong visibility, proximity to civic amenities, restaurants, retail, and public events, as well as a pedestrian-friendly environment that supports customer and employee engagement. This offering is ideal for investors or owner-users seeking a well-located, income-producing asset in one of Roseville's most active and evolving districts.
highlights: Rare freestanding commercial building in the heart of Old Town Roseville.
Charming 1,228 SF building thoughtfully updated for modern office / commercial use.
High visibility signage, on-site parking, full kitchen, large paved backyard, detached storage shed.
In-place commercial tenant, an early childhood education center provides immediate income.

listings.headline: Land For Sale | 0.76 AC
listings.description: CBRE is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire a prime ±0.76-acre campus-adjacent student housing land site located at 6325 and 6329 Elvas Avenue in Sacramento, California. Located less than 250 feet from the student pedestrian tunnel, the irreplaceable site provides immediate access to California State University Sacramento, making it an exceptional location to meet the growing need for high density student housing. The site is also situated just steps away from several popular retail options like Trader Joe’s, Starbucks, Jamba Juice, Subway, Dos Coyotes and other walkable local dining options. Sac State has experienced exponential growth over the last 20-years including increasing enrollment by 11% while investing over $385M in infrastructure upgrades; however the current housing landscape is insufficient to support the 31,500+ student population. Currently, there are just 3,200 beds available for students looking to live on campus, leaving almost a 10:1 student to bed ratio. Given the shortage of available student housing, there is exceptionally strong demand for nearby off-campus housing options. Current plans have been approved for a six-story, 94,926 square-foot building with 60 units and 283 beds. The Elvas Avenue land site is one of the most unique acquisition opportunities for an investor in the market today.

listings.description:
As exclusive advisor, CBRE is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire a leased commercial building with a fully-entitled development project, located at 6531 Folsom Boulevard in Sacramento, California.
The Subject Property is a high-quality urban infill site in East Sacramento on +/-.34 acres with fully approved entitlements for a mixed-use multifamily development, called Baobab Apartments. The Baobab Apartment Project is 6-story mixed use building consisting of 56 apartment units with a mix of 2-bed, 1-bed, and studio units. The project is designed with flexibility to be developed and operated as either market-rate multifamily or student housing of 66 beds. Amenities include a lounge, club room, bike room, courtyard on the 2nd floor, and common use amenity space. The project provides on-site parking for 16 vehicle stalls and 38 bicycle spaces. A 840 SF retail space is located on the ground floor along Folsom Blvd, a high traffic retail corridor.

The Subject Property presents a rare “covered land play” real estate strategy, producing income until redevelopment of the property can occur in opportune market conditions. The Property is 100% leased to a single commercial tenant, Jet Black Tint, on a long-term NNN lease with the ability for the owner to terminate the lease early, demolish the building, and start construction on the apartments. Boasting 100 feet of street frontage along Folsom Blvd, the building consists of approximately 1,800 SF showroom and office space and 3,160 SF dedicated warehouse space with a roll-up door accessible from the alley. Built in 1966, the Property features a large glass window line, exposed trusses throughout the warehouse, and corner visibility with monument signage. Additionally, the Property currently has 14 parking stalls in an area with heavily-constrained parking availability.

East Sacramento is one of the most affluent residential neighborhoods in the region. The site is conveniently located proximate to popular restaurants, cafes, schools, parks, grocery stores, and less than a quarter mile from CSU Sacramento and from the University/65th Street Light Rail Station. This site’s irreplaceable location makes it a prime opportunity for multifamily or student housing development. 6531 Folsom Blvd provides a developer an opportunity to acquire one of the most desirable sites available today with in-place cash flow until groundbreaking.

listings.description:
The offering at 7270–7298 Stockton Boulevard represents a rare opportunity
to acquire a unified 5.1‑acre development site strategically positioned within
one of South Sacramento’s most active and rapidly evolving commercial
corridors. Formerly marketed as two separate parcels, the property has now
been repositioned to highlight its strongest and most market‑responsive use: a
high‑density, garden‑style multifamily community supporting approximately 140–
175 units. This aligns with Sacramento County’s broader objectives for increased
housing production within designated Mixed Use Corridors.

The site benefits from LC (Light Commercial) zoning, flat topography, excellent
visibility, and immediate proximity to transit, employment, and retail amenities.
Its location along the Stockton Boulevard corridor provides strong long‑term
fundamentals, supported by continuous reinvestment and residential demand
in the surrounding neighborhoods. One parcel previously secured entitlement
approval for a 38‑units for‑rent townhome subdivision. Instead, the greatest value
lies in re‑entitling the combined acreage into a cohesive multifamily development.

Priced at $2,450,000—approximately $11 per square foot or $14,000–$17,000 per
potential multifamily unit—the property offers compelling land basis advantages
compared to competing sites in the region. This consolidated 5.1‑acre platform
provides developers with economies of scale, streamlined planning potential, and
the flexibility to pursue a high‑impact housing project aligned with Sacramento’s
evolving growth trajectory.
listings.locationDescription:
Unmatched Location in a Growing Urban Corridor: Positioned on the west side of Stockton Boulevard between Requa Way and 66th Avenue, this site sits in the heart of South Sacramento’s most active transportation and commercial spine. With excellent visibility, flat topography, and direct access to transit, retail, and services, the property offers immediate development functionality and long‑term economic upside.
Surrounding uses include:
• Multifamily apartments to the south
• Commercial services and additional LC‑zoned land to the east
• Multiple vacant LC parcels offering complementary development potential
• Established residential neighborhoods that reinforce ongoing housing demand
This location provides an ideal launch point for a scaled‑up residential community
that supports the County’s vision for intensified mixed‑use and multifamily infill along
key commercial corridors.
highlights: High‑Density Potential: Supports 140–175 garden‑style multifamily units, aligning with current housing demand and Mixed Use Corridor goals.
Strategic Location: Excellent visibility, transit access, and proximity to major retail and employment centers in South Sacramento.

Streamlined Entitlements: Previously approved plans for 38 condominium townhomes on the 2.3 acre parcel, provides a clear path for re-entitling the property for a new design.

listings.description: Meadowview Rd / 24th St. is 3.4 acres land centrally located at the gateway to the Delta Shores master planned community. The property consists of two (2) rectangular parcels zoned R-1. The property is a prime development opportunity providing many viable options for a project, highlighted by a residential multifamily, mixed-use project, or single family for sale subdivision. Under the new 2040 General Plan which went into effect in March 2024, the Property has land use designation of Residential Mixed Use (RMU). The single-unit zoned site could be subdivided into individual lots for single-family homes with up to two ADU’s on each lot. The minimum density is three (3) dwelling units per acre. Alternatively, the developer can take advantage of Sacramento’s first in the state Missing Middle Housing ordinance and have a maximum unit restriction based solely on the Maximum Floor Area Ratio (FAR). Based on land area of approximately 148,104 square feet, the site provides an opportunity to develop up to 296,200 square foot building.

listings.name: Alamo Square Portfolio
listings.headline: Alamo Square Portfolio
listings.description: A highly visible owner-user opportunity situated at a signalized, hard-corner intersection along Danville Boulevard and Stone Valley Road—one of the East Bay’s premier high-traffic commuter corridors with immediate access to Interstate 680. The offering is part of the Alamo Square Portfolio and includes Parcel One, comprising 3194 and 3196 Danville Boulevard, with the rare opportunity to also acquire Parcel Two at 37 Alamo Square Drive. Together, these assets present a unique opportunity to secure two legacy commercial properties in the heart of Alamo’s well-established and distinctive East Bay community.
listings.locationDescription: Anchored by decades of local history, 3194–3196 Danville Boulevard was formerly home to the beloved Alamo Hay & Grain Co., a community fixture dating back to 1962 and fondly remembered for its iconic rooftop horse statue and multigenerational customer base—making it one of Alamo’s most recognizable local landmarks. Just steps away, the plaza at 37 Alamo Square Drive is energized by artisans and neighborhood-serving retailers, including Lever Coffee, a popular local café that enhances the area’s welcoming, small-town charm and steady daily activity. Situated within Alamo’s walkable commercial core and surrounded by the natural beauty and community-oriented character of the San Ramon Valley, the portfolio benefits from strong local engagement and a loyal customer base drawn from adjacent residential neighborhoods. Prominently positioned along Danville Boulevard, the properties offer exceptional regional connectivity to Walnut Creek, Danville, Diablo, and major East Bay employment centers—making the Alamo Square Portfolio a compelling platform for future retail, service, or mixed-use development.

CBRE Capital Markets is pleased to offer the rare opportunity to acquire a fee simple interest in 394 S. 2nd Street & 384 S. 2nd Street (the “Property” or “Properties”), a development site located in the core of Downtown San Jose. 
The total area, comprised of three parcels, totals 21,428 square feet (.49 acres) of land and includes 20,280 square feet of existing retail and office improvements. The offering is being made unpriced on an “as-is, where-is” basis.
listings.locationDescription: The City of San Jose is the economic, cultural, and political center of Silicon Valley. Located in the center of the Santa Clara Valley, on the southern shore of the San Francisco Bay, San Jose covers an area of 179.97 square miles. San Jose sits within Santa Clara County, one of the most affluent counties in the United States. The Downtown core of San Jose is the most active submarket, which is currently experiencing a major urban transformation that will serve the City’s needs for decades to come. In addition to the proposed commercial developments, there are 3,700 new housing units in planning or under construction along with the Google Village project’s proposed 3,000-5,000 housing units. The surge in economic and population growth will be supported by a transportation infrastructure expansion of the Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) stations into Downtown San Jose. This will ultimately connect to the local VTA and Caltrain stations, allowing the labor force to access the entire Bay Area via public transit.

listings.name: 555 Post St - Procuring Commission & Seller Financing Available
listings.headline: Rare San Francisco Opportunity
listings.description:
CBRE, as exclusive advisor, is pleased to introduce a rare owner/user or investor opportunity to acquire the iconic building at 555 Post Street, in the premiere Union Square neighborhood of San Francisco, California.

555 Post Street is one of San Francisco's gems. Originally the home of the Union League Club and later the San Francisco Press Club, the classic, 7-story building plus penthouse is prominently located directly across the street from both the Olympic Club and the Bohemian Club, with Union Square and the Theater District just steps away. The neighborhood is clean, safe and accessible to all of the major tourist, convention, and business centers.

​​​​​​​The property was constructed in 1922, and features a full lower level complete with a swimming pool area; three floors plus mezzanine level of distinctive ballroom, meeting, classroom and office space featuring double height ceilings and exquisite design elements: these floors are currently available for occupancy. The upper four floors, plus penthouse, are leased on a long-term net basis to the next-door Hotel Zeppelin. All of the floors have abundant natural light. Long term local ownership has meticulously maintained the building.​​​​
highlights: San Francisco Poised for a Historic Recovery -The City has turned the corner with a new City administration and renewed activity in all property types, including office activity, multifamily, retail and hotel. There is a stronger outlook for conventions and tourism, as well as international and business travel.

Premier Union Square Location - The neighborhood remains one of the most attractive commercial districts on the West Coast, and is anchored by shopping and cultural landmarks. The building is located within the Union Square Business Improvement District, which provides resources for promoting the area, and keeping it clean and safe.
Open to Creative Deal Structures - Seller financing may be available, as well as lease options.

An Architectural Gem - Originally constructed for the home of the prestigious Union League Club in 1922, the steel frame building features distinctive public spaces, expansive ballrooms, a full lower level with pool area, large south facing outdoor terrace, and a layout that provides tremendous natural light throughout. The original woodwork, high ceilings, and unique design elements have been fastidiously maintained by an ownership team with deep experience with notable historic buildings in San Francisco.

Compelling Operating Features - The Property currently has its top four floors plus penthouse, leased on a long term net basis to the ownership of the adjacent boutique hotel, the Hotel Zeppelin. The Lease also provides the landlord with a valuable right of first refusal (ROFR) to acquire the adjacent property and operations. The building’s unique attributes and flexible zoning, allow an owner to use, develop, or lease the 30,000 SF of available space for assembly, hospitality, retail and/or office uses that allow for a broad range of operations including events, school, church, hotel, spa, speakeasy, bar, co-working, or restaurant.

listings.headline: Outstanding Boutique Hotel Opportunity
listings.description:
CBRE Hotels is pleased to present the unique opportunity to acquire Sutter Mansion (“Hotel” or “Property”) in San Francisco, CA.

Sutter Mansion, located in the popular Japan Town, Pacific Heights area in the city represents an exceptional investment opportunity. The Property has been well invested in, is full of historic charm, and is available unencumbered by brand and management.

The boutique hotel from San Francisco's grand Victorian era was designed by Architect William F. Curlett. Offering 12 well-appointed guestrooms and suites, each were designed to provide a comfortable and memorable experience for guests.  

Strategically positioned within close proximity to San Francisco's downtown financial district, Japan Town, and residential neighborhoods, the Hotel caters well to both leisure and business travelers, benefiting from a diverse clientele. The property boasts state-of-the-art amenities, including a full-service restaurant, two commercial kitchens, and versatile meeting spaces, making it an ideal venue for buyouts and transient guests. ​​​​​​​

With the opportunity to add two new hotel rooms and an additional two ADU units, this offering represents a rare chance to acquire a well-established hotel, with partial rental income and opportunities for improved revenues.​​​​​​​
listings.locationDescription:
GRAND VICTORIAN ICON IN SAN FRANCISCO - Represents one of San Francisco's classic Grand Victorian properties, maintaining much of its original architectural character and historic detail.
 
LARGE GUESTROOMS AND SUITES - Hotel features guestrooms and suites averaging ~400 sq. ft. making them significantly larger than typical boutique hotels in San Francisco, offering more flexible layouts and enhanced in-room amenities.

WELL-SUITED FOR CORPORATE BUYOUTS - Sutter Mansion’s small room count, three distinct event spaces, high‑speed Wi‑Fi, AV capabilities, and capacity of up to 130 guests create a flexible environment that has attracted off‑site buyouts, workshops, and executive retreats.

STABLE LEASED INCOME COMPONENT - Portion of the property is supported by existing leased income that contributes steady, predictable revenue on a recurring basis.

CAPACITY TO ADD TWO ADDITIONAL HOTEL ROOMS - Current configuration presents a practical expansion opportunity that does not require major structural alterations or significant disruption to current operations.
 
OPTION TO DEVELOP TWO ADU UNITS - Property offers the potential to add two Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), which could serve as extended-stay lodging, employee housing, or independent rental units.

COMPLETE FLEXIBILITY FOR NEW OWNER - Offered unencumbered by management and brand, providing complete flexibility for a new owner.

AI FUELS MARKET REBOUND - San Francisco’s economy is being driven by a rapid AI boom that is expanding office demand, generating tens of thousands of new jobs, and positioning the city for a major recovery across tech, real estate, and hospitality.

SAN FRANCISCO TOP U.S. REVPAR GROWTH MARKET IN 2025 - San Francisco’s hotel sector is rapidly rebounding, powered by a strong convention calendar, renewed business travel, and rising luxury leisure demand, leading the nation with 11.8% RevPAR growth in 2025.

listings.name: Premier Place
listings.headline: MAUI - Class A Multi-Tenant Office Investment Opportunity
listings.description:
CBRE Capital Markets, as exclusive advisor, is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire the fee simple interest in Premier Place (the “property”). The property consists of a two-story class-A low rise office building totaling 47,732 square feet on 2.81 acres of land. ​​​​​​​The Building has been institutionally owned and managed since 2021. It is currently 97.5% leased to a highly diversified group of national, local, and government tenants with the largest tenant having the longest lease term. With institutional-grade credit tenants, rents well below market, and a WALT of 4.25 years, this is a core-plus investment opportunity with value-add traits.

Constructed in 1991, Premier Place is a two-story, multi-tenant corporate style office building situated on a professionally landscaped parcel that offers generous on-site parking and contemporary architectural design. The building has consistently demonstrated strong historical occupancy and currently enjoys stable in-place tenancy, providing secure cash flow and operational stability.

​​​​​​​With upside potential through mark-to-market rents, Premier Place offers investors a unique opportunity to capitalize on long-term value in one of Hawaii’s most supply-constrained office markets, with close adjacency to the luxury Wailea market. The combination of location, tenant mix, and market fundamentals position Premier Place as a best-in-class investment opportunity in Maui.
listings.locationDescription: Positioned at 535 Lipoa Parkway within the prestigious Maui Research & Technology Park, the property benefits from a well-established presence in a dynamic business environment surrounded by a diverse mix of local and national companies, healthcare providers, and government agencies.
highlights: NET LEASED CLASS A OFFICE INVESTMENT - A net leased multi-tenant investment opportunity with lease security and excellent WALT. The largest tenant has the longest lease term.

listings.name: 3588 Waialae Ave | Queen Theater
listings.headline: An Iconic Honolulu Fee Simple Property | For Sale
listings.description:
CBRE is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire the Queen Theater, an iconic fee simple commercial property located at 3588 Waialae Avenue in the Kaimukī neighborhood of Honolulu, Hawaii. Originally constructed in 1936, the Queen Theater is a long‑standing and well‑recognized asset situated along Waialae Avenue, Kaimukī’s primary commercial corridor.


The Property comprises approximately 12,497 square feet of improvements on a 10,396‑square‑foot land parcel and is zoned B‑2 (Community Business District). The asset is positioned as a covered land investment, with existing improvements supporting interim use while preserving long‑term flexibility for adaptive reuse or repositioning.


Offered fee simple and as‑is, the Queen Theater represents a rare opportunity to control a prominent commercial site within a built‑out, supply‑constrained Honolulu neighborhood. The offering is well suited for investors seeking long‑term ownership of a legacy asset with durable location fundamentals and future optionality.
listings.locationDescription: Honolulu, Oahu, Hawaii
highlights: ICONIC FEE SIMPLE OWNERSHIP IN A HIGH BARRIERS‑TO‑ENTRY MARKET - Opportunity to acquire a long‑standing, well‑recognized commercial property held in fee simple within one of Honolulu’s most established neighborhood corridors, where fee simple assets of scale are rarely available.

COVERED LAND INVESTMENT IN A SUPPLY‑CONSTRAINED SUBMARKET - Positioned as a covered land investment in Kaimukī, a built‑out and supply‑constrained submarket characterized by limited new commercial development and high barriers to entry.

ADAPTIVE REUSE AND LONG‑TERM OPTIONALITY - Existing improvements support interim use while preserving long‑term flexibility for adaptive reuse or repositioning, subject to applicable approvals, allowing an investor to control timing and strategy.

ESTABLISHED URBAN INFILL LOCATION ALONG WAIALAE AVENUE  - Prominent frontage along Waialae Avenue, Kaimukī’s primary commercial spine, within a dense residential trade area and a corridor defined by enduring demand and limited replacement opportunities.

RARE AVAILABILITY OF LEGACY ASSETS  - Opportunities to acquire iconic, fee simple properties of this nature in Kaimukī are infrequent, underscoring the asset’s long‑term ownership relevance for investors seeking durable location fundamentals.
